**Audit date:** 2026-09-02 · **Method:** full read of every renderer file, no sampling · **Evidence standard:** every Template below is copied verbatim from source with `file:line` locators; 12/12 randomized spot-checks by the lead auditor matched source exactly.

Origin's two newest commits postdate the last verified server sync, so server state may lack `454d259a` (reactions fallback chain). Everything else was content-identical as of the last live check.

## 1. How to read this document

Every user-facing render block in the bot is catalogued as an entry:

```
### UI-<SECTION>-<NN> — <element name>
- Loc:       file.js:START-END        ← exact source locator
- Trigger:   command or flow          ← what makes it render
- Type:      menu|list|card|stat-screen|combat-round|leaderboard|confirm|error|progress|notification|caption|other
- Banner:    header mechanism used
- Template:  LITERAL code template (placeholders kept as ${...})
- Example:   one filled-in render as the user sees it
- Notes:     style quirks, dead paths, bugs
```

Identical-except-values variants share one entry. Loop-rendered screens (per-class trees, per-floor headers, per-card rows) are one entry describing the loop template. Big data tables are described with sample rows, not dumped.

## 3. The send layer — how text reaches users

Five distinct delivery mechanisms coexist (this is itself a consistency problem):

1. **Direct `sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: BOT_MARKER + ... })`** — engine.js (1,350+ sites), all 8 command files, guildAdventure, reactions handler.
2. **`reply(...)`** — cardSystem/itemMarket legacy pattern (~253 sites, no BOT_MARKER).
3. **`result.message` relay** — engine.js calls rpg modules and forwards `{ success, message }` strings verbatim (~100 relay sites; the message body is authored in the module).
4. **`sendMenuWithBanner(sock, chatId, text)`** — banner.png image with text (menus only; text fallback if image send fails).
5. **Image/video with caption** — card art, combat images (Go service + node-canvas), roster MP4s/PNGs; caption text authored at the send site.

**BOT_MARKER** (`\u200B` zero-width space, engine.js:1252) marks bot-vs-user messages. Applied inconsistently: missing on all `reply()` paths, ping, vote results, `record` command, rank commands, busy notices, game passthroughs; adminConsole uses a *different* marker (ZWSP), progressionCommands uses a visible `🃏 *BOTNAME*` header, repairCommands uses none.

| `GET_BANNER(title)` | engine.js:4849 | Box banner: `┏━(15)━┓ / ┃   title / ┗━(15)━┛` (title row never closed with `┃`) |
| `sendMenuWithBanner()` | engine.js:4910 | banner.png image + text, text fallback |

| `COMMAND_REGISTRY` | core/utils/commandRegistry.js | 385 commands / 22 categories — the menu backbone |
| `sendUsage()` | engine.js:2573 | GET_BANNER usage card for unknown/malformed commands |
| `BOT_MARKER` | engine.js:1252 | ZWSP anti-spoof marker |
| `botConfig.getCurrency()` | botConfig.js | currency symbol (but 4 render paths / 2 accessors exist) |

These are the **only sanctioned** primitives — and the audit found the codebase uses them in a minority of screens. Sections below catalog the actual state.

## 5. Reference-quality elements (candidates for the unified style — Task 1 step 2)

Per the v3 spec ("the unified style should come from the bot's own best existing UI"), these existing elements are the strongest references:

1. **Skill tree screen** (`skillCommands.js:16-114`, `displaySkillTree`) — praised by testers; class-themed emoji headers, branch structure, per-node state icons (locked/learned/maxed), progress line. See §90 UI-SK-01.
2. **Main menu** (`engine.js:5046-5113`) — GET_BANNER banner, 2-column category grid, rotating tips, category drill-down + command explain (3-level navigation). See §20.
3. **Summon roster 3-tier render** (`summonRosterRenderer.js`) — Go GIF → PNG → text degradation, same content each tier. See §95.
4. **Profile card image** (`profileCardRenderer.js`) — node-canvas card with deliberate "NO EMOJIS" policy in-image vs emoji caption. See §110.
5. **PvP duel challenge card** (pvpSystem.js — freeform but complete: stakes, HP, turn order, footer hint). See §105.

## 6. Cross-cutting defects found during the inventory (feed for Tasks 1–7)

### 6.1 Banner anarchy — 6+ competing header systems, dozens of hand-measured widths

| Style | Where | Widths seen |
|---|---|---|
| `GET_BANNER` ┏━┓ | engine menus (the intended one) | 15 |
| Hand-rolled ┏━┓ copies | balance/history/profile (engine p5/p6), classCommands | 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 23, 25, 27, 30-34 |
| `╔═╗` boxes | anime cards, classCommands, gambling, blackjack | 22 (+mismatched rails 13/14) |
| `╭─╮` boxes | broadcast, handbook | 19 |
| `━` divider frames | debate, monster guide, summon, economy | 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20 |
| Plain emoji+bold headers | economy, invest, stocks, most one-liners | — |

Even `GET_BANNER` itself is malformed (title row never closed). Divider width drifts *within single messages* (search list header 19 vs footer 15).

### 6.2 Literal `\n` rendered to users (Task 4 family — CONFIRMED, exact registry)

Double-escaped `\\n` in normal-quoted strings → users see literal backslash-n. **engine.js:12388, 12410, 12434, 12463-12467, 12509** (editissue / deleteissue / lookupban / pardon family — the exact bug the testers reported), plus the HISTORY/membership/portfolio templates in engine p6 and loan templates (`loans.js:163-171, 239-243` mix real newlines and `\n` escapes). rpg modules themselves are clean (0 artifacts in the 10 economy/social files) — the bug is engine-side.

### 6.3 Un-interpolated `${...}` printed literally (single-quote bugs)

engine.js **8503, 10099, 11813, 17934, 18050, 18055, 18062, 18071, 18639, 18652** — users literally see `` `${botConfig.getPrefix()} register` ``. Plus missing-space joins: `${getPrefix()}use` → `.juse`, `${getPrefix()}accept` → `.jaccept`, `${botConfig.getPrefix()}ping` → `.jping`; hardcoded prefixes: `.jk` in `.j diag` (breaks non-Joker instances), `.summon` literals, `.g solo dragon`.

### 6.4 Dead / unreachable render paths

- `cmdT2CDeck` defined twice, byte-identical (cardSystem.js:2365 & 2629)
- Duplicate `.claim` handler (engine.js:22687 vs 23453, second unreachable, texts diverged)
- Unreachable `.j sell` (engine.js:11538-11562)
- `summonCodexRenderer` imported, never called; `summonAchievements` has no caller; `cardLine()`/`sendCardMedia()` dead; `formatNewsDigest` dead; `socialSystem.getRelationshipsText` has zero callers (no marriage UI exists)
- `performEnemyAction_new.js` — orphaned file (undefined globals), never imported
- Raid spawn/victory + war spawn messages are console.log-only — schedulers discard `.message` (users never see them)
- `admin sandbox fightboss` crashes on `const sub` reassignment before its redirect text (adminConsole.js:1877)
- `.summon evolve/equip/bond/traits/ai <id>` — `summonNum` ReferenceError ×5 → 13 entries dead paths (summonCommands.js:1751/1812/1941/1972/2081)
- summonTrials references 14 species deleted from registry → `.summon trial` always errors
- Search results have NO numeric-reply path at all (the "dead/duplicate numeric-reply render path" = `.info` hard-caps top-15 with no pagination while `.cs` paginates the same list — see §85)

### 6.5 Icon / grammar / data-display chaos

- **Tier icons:** 6 competing per-view `tierEmoji` maps vs global `TIER_STARS`; spawn/detail captions fall back to `'✆'` (a phone glyph!)
- **Rarity icons:** 3 schemes (`RARITY_ICONS` 🔵🟣🟠🔴 vs `rarityEmojis` 🔷🔮👑🌌 vs `RARITY_MARK` ✦★)
- **HP bars:** `█░` vs `▰▱` glyph sets
- **PvE/PvP grammar drift:** `atk/skill/def` vs `attack/ability`
- **Balance labels:** `New Balance` / `New Wallet Balance` / `Wallet Balance` / `Balance`
- **Currency:** `getCurrency().symbol` vs `economy.getZENI()` vs `ZENI()` vs "Zeni" word
- Raw internal enums leak to users (`FROST_GHOUL`, `VOLATILE`, `rare_summon_egg`, `attack` stat keys, `heal` effect keys)
- WhatsApp-markup defects: `**double bold**` renders literally; unbalanced backticks in register-first (5 sites), bag footer, horse usage
- Wrong display text: PvP flee footer says "50% Wallet" (code: 10%, cap 5K); raid shows "Lv FIGHTER"; trivia advertises +50 XP, grants 45; respec error claims 100K×level, code is 1K×level; synergy tip claims 50% wear reduction, code ±15%; roulette shows fake "spin history"; top-3 all print 🥇🥈🥉
- Emoji defects: `⚠️️` double selector; `🎟` vs `🎟️` mixed in one game; `NaNM members` when data missing

### 6.6 Tester-issue evidence found in-code (Task 7)

- **569120 (abyss same sprite):** `combatImageGenerator.js:43` — `spriteIndex: Number(e.spriteIndex)||0` → always 0 for abyss enemies; `bossId` becomes a timestamp-garbage key that never matches the Go sprite map. Root cause confirmed.
- **5690ff (Pyraxis no sprite):** species id `dragon` absent from `summonSprites.js` local PNGs, DIGIMON_API overrides, AND `KNOWN_MISSING` → failed digi-api fetch every render; roster grid tier draws blank portrait (no emoji fallback in that tier).
- **5672a0 (animated cards):** T6/S/event video-vs-image ladder inlined 7× in cardSystem; roster MP4 title "SUMMON ROSTER" vs PNG/text "SUMMON CODEX" — same-screen naming drift.
- **568c1e / 5691d3 / 56918d:** enemy types are string-IDs with tier-generic stats; bossMechanics registry never applied to abyss bosses (no archetype skills like "dragonfall"); abyss HP scaling visible in abyssSystem (plateau analysis still to be done).
- **Reactions (Task 4):** config is 82 commands (not 85); current chain nekos.best (kept despite Cloudflare-403) → nekos.life v2 → PurrBot v2; waifu.pics removed; failure path leaks raw `error.message` to chat.

### UI-E1-01 — Anime search: no results
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:1338-1343`
- **Trigger:** `.j anime <query>` (handleAnimeSearch) — Jikan returns empty list
- **Type:** error
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
BOT_MARKER + "No results found on Jikan/MAL."
```
- **Example render:**
```

```
- **Notes:** Preceded by a `❌` reaction on the invoking message (L1339). Single line, no emoji in the text itself (reaction carries the ❌).

### UI-E1-02 — Anime search: results list
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:1345-1350` (built), sent 1359-1363 as quoted reply
- **Trigger:** `.j anime <query>` — successful Jikan search
- **Type:** list
- **Banner:** plain bold header `🔎 *Search results for:*` + `━` divider (19 chars), footer divider only 15 chars
- **Template:**
```
let menu = `🔎 *Search results for:* ${query}\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n`;
list.slice(0, 15).forEach((a, i) => {
  const type = a.type ? `[${a.type}]` : "";
  menu += `*${i + 1}.* ${a.title} ${type}\n`;
});
menu += `\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n*Reply with a number (1-${Math.min(15, list.length)}) for details.*`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
🔎 *Search results for:* cowboy bebop
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
*1.* Cowboy Bebop [TV]
*2.* Cowboy Bebop: Tengoku no Tobira [Movie]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
*Reply with a number (1-15) for details.*
```
- **Notes:** Header divider is 19 `━` but footer divider is 15 `━` — inconsistent within the SAME message. Results cached 5 min (300000 ms); reply-with-number flow reads the cache. Sent with `BOT_MARKER +` prefix and `{ quoted: m }`. No GET_BANNER box — unlike news list (UI-E1-15).

### UI-E1-04 — Anime trending card (image + caption)
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:1395-1405` (caption at 1399)
- **Trigger:** `.j trending` (handleAnimeTrending)
- **Type:** caption
- **Banner:** emoji ALL-CAPS header `🔥 *ANIME TRENDING* 🔥` + 19-char `━` divider (no GET_BANNER box)
- **Template:**
```
const caption = `🔥 *ANIME TRENDING* 🔥\n\n🎬 *${pick.title}*\n⭐ Score: ${pick.score || "N/A"}\n\n📖 *Synopsis:* ${(pick.synopsis || "").slice(0, 280)}...\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n📥 *WATCH:* ${watchLink}\n🔗 MAL: ${pick.url}`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
🔥 *ANIME TRENDING* 🔥

🎬 *Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood*
⭐ Score: 9.09

📖 *Synopsis:* After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong in the Elric household, brothers Edward and Alphonse are severely damaged...
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📥 *WATCH:* https://anikai.to/watch/fullmetal-alchemist-brotherhood-episode-1
🔗 MAL: https://myanimelist.net/anime/5114
```
- **Notes:** Sent via `sendImageSafe(sock, chatId, imageUrl, BOT_MARKER + caption, m)` — text is an image CAPTION, not plain text. Synopsis hard-truncated at 280 chars with literal `...` appended even when text shorter (always ends "..."). Random pick from top-10 by popularity. `🔥` react first, `✅` react on success.

---

## Cross-cutting style findings (range 1–4500)

1. **Divider length drift:** `━` dividers are 19 chars in anime cards, 15 chars in search footer/GET_BANNER/graveyard — mixed within a single message (UI-E1-02).
2. **Nine distinct error wordings** for the same "upstream API failed" class: "Search failed…", "Could not fetch trending/airing/a random anime.", "⚠️ API is busy…", "❌ Anime service is busy.", "❌ API overloaded.", "❌ Ranking Engine Error.", "⚠️ Search service busy.", "❌ Scrape failed.", "❌ Failed to fetch images." — plus 3 duplicated `❌ No results found.` blocks.
3. **BOT_MARKER inconsistency:** loan notifications (L3286-3304) omit the zero-width `BOT_MARKER` that every other message in range prepends.
4. **Caption vs plain text:** anime/studio cards = image captions (via sendImageSafe); audio song info = plain text relying on WA link previews; img/nsfw/adult = images with `""` empty captions; graveyard = banner.png caption. Four different text/image relationships.
5. **Emoji header sandwich pattern** (`🔥 *ANIME TRENDING* 🔥`) is used by all anime cards except anime news (GET_BANNER box) — two competing header systems in the same handler family.
6. **Dead/odd code:** `a.members` NaN risk (UI-E1-19), hardcoded Dragon Ball URL, `.j top` shows random of top-25, Serper API key hardcoded (L1547).
## Section 20 — engine.js part 2 (lines 4501–9000)

Coverage: all 4500 lines of core/engine.js L4501–9000 read via ~450-line windows; boundary blocks (`.j search` fall-through → anime handler L9001+, `sendUsage` L2573) peeked to confirm. 52 entries cataloged below. Pure console.log output (login/pairing/QR boxes L5578-5631, connect logs) excluded per rules. Delegate-only handlers (`.j blacksmith/repair/inspect/profile/shop/skills/summon/...` → external command modules) noted in entry UI-E2-52; their renders belong to other files' sections.

## Section 30 — engine.js part 3 (lines 9001–13500)

- **Coverage:** lines 9001–13500 read in full via ~450-line windows; boundary blocks that straddle 13500 (antispam 13485–13525) included fully. Boundary neighbor `.g warn` (13527+) belongs to section 31.
- **Entries:** 117 entries. `BOT_MARKER` = zero-width space `\u200B` (L1252) — invisible to users, prepended to most sends. `sendUsage()` (L~2347) renders `GET_BANNER(title)` + description/usage/example lines. `reply()` (L6569) prepends BOT_MARKER + quotes the user's message.
- **Notable quirks:** 7 messages contain LITERAL `\n` (visible backslash-n) at L12388/12410/12434/12463–12467/12509; 2 messages have un-interpolated `${...}` inside double quotes (L10099, L11813); `.g unpin` no-reply hint references out-of-scope `P` (L13102) → ReferenceError.

---

## Cross-cutting observations (range 9001–13500)

1. **Four coexisting menu styles:** GET_BANNER box + sendUsage (▫️ bullets), ━-divider bold sections (tutorial/rank/networth), `── section ──` + `▸` (sticker menu), and bare bold headers with no structure (most one-liner notifications).
2. **Three admin-denial wordings:** "you need to be an admin to use this command." / "❌ Admins only." / "❌ No permission." — plus casual lowercase variants ("i need to be an admin to kick users.").
3. **Literal `\n` bug family** (visible backslash-n to users): editissue/deleteissue success, lookupban, pardon (L12388, 12410, 12434, 12463-12467, 12509) — while sibling commands 30 lines away use real `\n`.
4. **Un-interpolated `${...}` in double-quoted strings:** ban mod-only error (L10099) and addmod owner warning (L11813) print the raw template text.
5. **Broken scope reference:** `.g unpin` no-reply hint (L13102) uses `${P}` declared only inside the glock block → ReferenceError; guard never renders.
6. **Dead code:** unreachable duplicate `.j sell` handler (L11538-11562) with its own usage screen.
7. **Reaction choreography** (emoji reacts on the triggering message) is pervasive: 🔍/⏳/✅/❌/🎣/🏹/🎮 patterns bookend most async commands.
8. **Marker inconsistency:** fish/hunt results, toimg/tovid captions+errors, and sendMenuWithBanner sends omit BOT_MARKER; nearly everything else prepends it.
## Section 40 — engine.js part 4 (lines 13501–18000)

- **Coverage:** read in full via 12 sequential windows (13501–18010, no gaps); boundary blocks that start before 13501 (antispam handler) or spill past 18000 (abyss `enter`) are included where their send-block sits inside the range.
- **Volume:** 215 entries below. Byte-identical templates repeated across handlers (e.g. `❌ Groups only.`, `❌ Failed: ` + e.message, `❌❌ Failed to <verb>!`, `result.message` passthroughs) are consolidated into grouped entries with occurrence lists; every distinct text is quoted verbatim.
- **Context:** every `sock.sendMessage` in this section prefixes `BOT_MARKER` (zero-width space `\u200B`, L1252) — invisible to users. `reply(...)` calls (rank system, L13843+) have **no** marker, an inconsistency vs the rest of the file.

### UI-E4-79 — Rank system guide
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:14606-14636`
- **Trigger:** `.g rank guide`
- **Type:** menu (long-form guide)
- **Banner:** `🏅 *GROUP RANK SYSTEM GUIDE* 🏅` + `─`×24
- **Template:**
```
🏅 *GROUP RANK SYSTEM GUIDE* 🏅
────────────────────────

*1. Rank Hierarchy & Protections*
Members are assigned to Rank Tiers (1 to 5).
• *Rank 4 & 5 (Superadmin)* can manage ranks, titles, and use all admin commands.
• *Lower ranks (1-3)* can only use basic commands unless explicitly allowed.
• *Protection:* You can NEVER edit the rank, title, or permissions of someone at an equal or higher rank than yourself.

*2. Setting Up Ranks*
`.g rank setup` - Initialize default 5 tiers.
`.g rank add <level> <icon> <name>` - Add custom tier.
`.g rank remove <level>` - Delete a tier.

*3. Managing Members*
`.g set rank @user <level>` - Assign a rank.
`.g unrank @user` - Remove assigned rank.
`.g title set @user <title>` - Give custom title.
`.g title remove @user` - Remove title.

*4. Command Permissions*
`.g rank allow <level> <cmd>` - Whitelist an admin command for a lower rank (e.g., `.g rank allow 2 kick`).
`.g rank deny <level> <cmd>` - Blacklist a command for a senior rank.
`.g rank perms` - View all active rules.

*5. Viewing Ranks*
`.g ranks` - View the rank ladder.
`.g who` - View the full styled group roster.
`.g myrank` / `.g rankinfo @user` - Check details.
```
- **Example render:** static (prefix filled `.g`).
- **Notes:** real multi-line template literal (actual newlines) unlike most `\n`-escaped blocks in this section. Not BOT_MARKER-prefixed (plain `reply(guideText)`).

• *Dragonslayer (Tier 2):* The elite hunter. Gains *Dragon Bane* (3x damage vs dragons).
• *Dragon God (Tier 3):* Ascended deity. Gains *Dragon Heart* (Immunity to all status effects + 50% damage reduction).

*Path of the Hunter:* 
1. Must be a member of the *Fighter* lineage (Warrior, Berserker, Paladin).
2. Reach Level 40 and complete 30 Quests.
3. Buy a *Dragon Seal Ring* 💍🐲 (20,000 Zeni) - Required to damage dragons!
4. Buy a *Dragon Hunter Key* 🔑🐲 from the shop (15,000 Zeni).
5. Enter the *Dragon's Lair* using `.g solo dragon`.
6. Slay the Ancient Dragon to earn a *Dragon Heart*.
7. Use `.g evolve` with the heart and 150,000 Zeni!

*Path of the Deity:* 
1. Reach Level 70 and complete 75 Quests.
2. Defeat 200 Dragons.
3. Pay 500,000 Zeni to ascend.
```
- **Example render:** static (prefix filled).
- **Notes:** trailing spaces after `*Path of the Hunter:*` and `*Path of the Deity:*`.

- **Template:**
```
⚙️ *DURABILITY & REPAIRS*

• *Durability:* Equipped gear has a condition rating (from 0 to max). Stacked inventory items do not have durability.
• *Wear:* Weapons lose durability when attacking; armor loses durability when hit. Optimal class-weapon synergies reduce wear by 50%.

  - 100%-40%: Full gear stats.
  - 39%-1%: 40% stat reduction.
  - 0%: 💔 *[BROKEN]* - 0% stats!
• *Repair:* Use `.g blacksmith` to view status, or `.g repair <slot/index/all>` to fix gear with Zeni.
• *Repair Kits:* Brew consumable kits and apply in the field with `.g use <kit_id/index> <slot>`.
```

- **Template:**
```

📋 *Titled Members:*

### UI-E4-175 — Rune system help menu
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:17360-17375`
- **Trigger:** `.g rune` / `.g rune help`
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** `💎 *RUNE SYSTEM* 💎`
- **Template:**
```
💎 *RUNE SYSTEM* 💎

Socket runes into skills to modify their behavior. Runes drop exclusively from the Abyss (Floor 21+).

*Commands:*
• `.g rune inv` — view your rune inventory
• `.g rune list` — list all rune types
• `.g rune socket <runeName> <skillId or #>` — socket a rune
• `.g rune remove <runeName>` — remove a rune (needs scroll)
• `.g rune destroy <runeName>` — destroy a socketed rune
• `.g rune slots <skillId>` — check slot capacity for a skill
• `.g rune fuse <type> [count|all]` — fuse same-type same-tier runes
• `.g rune sell <runeId> <price>` — list a rune for sale
• `.g rune buy <listingId>` — buy a listed rune
• `.g rune market` — browse runes for sale
```
- **Example render:** static (prefix filled `.g`).
- **Notes:** bullet style `•` + em-dash descriptions; remove/destroy help say `<runeName>` but code paths label them `<runeId>` — minor mismatch.

Place Zeni bounties on other players. Bounty hunters track via PvP. Adds risk to hoarding wealth.

*Rules:*
• Min bounty: 100K Zeni | Max: 50M Zeni
• Target must be level 20+
• Max 3 active bounties per target
• 24h cooldown between placements by same user
• 7-day expiry with Zeni refund
• Hunter fee: 5% to hunter's guild treasury
• Failed hunt: hunter pays 10% penalty to target
• Targets with bounties CANNOT use the bank (deposit OR withdraw)
• 💡 Defender wins: if the target defeats 3 challengers, the bounty auto-clears (no refund to placer)

*Commands:*
• `.g bounty place @target <amount>` — place a bounty
• `.g bounty list` — top 10 active bounties
• `.g bounty target` — bounties on you
• `.g bounty mine` — bounties you placed
• `.g bounty cancel <bountyId>` — cancel (10% fee)
• `.g bounty admin` — admin commands

_Claim bounties by winning PvP duels against the target. The bounty auto-claims on win._
```
- **Example render:** static (prefix filled `.g`).
- **Notes:** trailing double `\n\n` before the italic footer (extra blank line as shipped).

### UI-E4-215 — `result.message` passthrough sends (grouped)
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:13969-13970` (rank mission claim), 15848-15850 (guild join), 15867-15869 (guild leave), 16544-16546 (guild motto set), 16809-16811 (guild upgrade buy), 17154-17155 (guild role set), 17261 (guild purge), 17339-17341 (guild challenge issue), 17599 (rune socket), 17616 (rune fuse), 17636 (rune remove), 17650 (rune destroy), 17793 (bounty place), 17874 (bounty cancel), 17900 (bounty admin cancel), 17904 (bounty admin purge), 17998-17999 & 18007 (abyss enter)
- **Trigger:** success/fail outcomes whose copy lives in rpg/* modules
- **Type:** other (delegated render)
- **Banner:** whatever the owning module emits (outside this range)
- **Template:** `BOT_MARKER + result.message` — no local template
- **Example render:** e.g. `.g rune fuse power all` → `✅ Fused 2 Power (Lesser) into 1 Power (Normal)!` (owned by rpg/runeSystem)
- **Notes:** failure variants from these same handlers use the local `❌ Failed: ${e.message}` family (UI-E4-122), so a user can see two very different styles for success vs failure of the same command.

---

## Dead / unreachable code in range (no entries — NOT live UI)
- **L15400-15465** — entire legacy block (recipes / mine / source / craft / brew / dismantle / lore) is commented out (`/* ... */`), including a fully-written `🌌 *THE CHRONICLES OF THE REALMS* 🌌` lore screen. It is unreachable; live lore content only exists via `guide lore` (UI-E4-104).
- **L17162-17163** — `.g dragonkills` condition duplicates the same string twice (`||` identical operands) — harmless but dead second clause.

## Cross-range style notes (summary of inconsistencies)
1. **Banner anarchy:** four competing header systems — GET_BANNER box (usage screens), hand-rolled `┏━┓` boxes (tagall, RPG handbook `╭╮`), `╔═╗` boxes (guild list/leaderboard/points), plain emoji+bold headers (everything else). Box widths are hand-counted and mismatched (e.g. leaderboard top 14 vs bottom 13 rails; tagall 13 vs 14 vs 15).
2. **Literal `${botConfig.getPrefix()}` leak:** 5 single-quoted strings (UI-E4-23, -25, -27, -194, -211) print the placeholder verbatim to users. Plus one hard-coded `.j` prefix (UI-E4-143) and one hard-coded `.g solo dragon` (UI-E4-168).
3. **Two failure dialects:** legacy `❌❌ Failed to <verb>!` (guild cluster) vs modern `❌ Failed: ${e.message}` (rune/bounty/phase-2 guild) — raw exception text leaks in the latter.
4. **Newline style split:** rank/guild/rune/bounty screens use `\n`-escaped concatenation; rank guide, tagall, guild invitations, dragonkills, archetype-change use real multi-line template literals.
5. **BOT_MARKER inconsistency:** rank-system commands send via `reply()` with NO marker, everything else prefixes the invisible marker.
6. **Progress bars:** 10-cell (rank mission) vs 20-cell (dragonkills) bars; count grammar bug `(1 bounties)`; duplicated menu row (`guide stats` listed twice); pvp guide header has a stray leading space/emoji.
# UI Inventory — Section 50

## Section 50 — engine.js part 5 (lines 18001–22500)
- **Coverage:** `core/engine.js` L18001–L22500 read in full (21 read windows, ~220 lines each); boundary overlap L17896–18000 (abyss enter block start) and L22501–22564 (vote/equip passthroughs) included for context.
- **Scope:** Abyss, Raid, Guild War, activity/userinfo, 18+/nsfw/img/audio, anime news/details, roast/powerscale/8ball/ship, joke/truth/dare/motivate/fact/define/rate/meme/wyr/quote/weather/translate/crypto/trivia/qr/short/git/animequote/cat-dog/waifu/record, tag-everyone confirm, trivia answer flow, accept/decline/duel/pvp, item/vote shortcuts.
- **Entry count:** 156 entries. Shared families ("❌ Failed:" catch-all, sendUsage banner cards, "❌ Usage:" one-liners, result.message passthroughs, emoji reactions) are grouped into single entries with full location lists.

# B. RAID COMMANDS (`.g raid …`) — L18318–18540

### UI-E5-25 — WEEKLY RAID — AVATAR MODE help menu
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:18325-18348`
- **Trigger:** `.g raid` or `.g raid help`
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** plain bold ALL-CAPS with flanking ⚔️ (`⚔️ *WEEKLY RAID — AVATAR MODE* ⚔️`)
- **Template:**
```
⚔️ *WEEKLY RAID — AVATAR MODE* ⚔️

Every Sunday 00:00 UTC, a server-wide raid boss spawns. All joined players merge into "The Avatar" — a single entity whose class, stats, and skills are determined by the participants.

*How it works:*
• Join the raid with `${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid join`
• Each round, vote for which skill the Avatar uses (`${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid vote 1-5`)
• 60-second voting window per round
• Most-voted skill is executed, then boss attacks back
• Continues until boss dies (win) or all attackers dead (loss)

*Boss Rotation (4 weeks):*
• Week 1: Elder Chaos (physical-resist)
• Week 2: Void Titan (magic-resist)
• Week 3: Abyssal God (immune to weak attacks)
• Week 4: Ancient Dragon (requires dragon seal ring)

*Rewards:*
• Top 3: 500K XP + 200K Zeni + Greater Rune
• Top 10: 200K XP + 100K Zeni + Normal Rune
• Top 50: 100K XP + 50K Zeni
• All participants: 10K XP + 5K Zeni

*Commands:*
• `${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid status` — view current raid
• `${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid join` — join the raid
• `${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid vote <1-5>` — vote for a skill
• `${botConfig.getPrefix()} raid leaderboard` — all-time top contributors
```
- **Example render:**
```
⚔️ *WEEKLY RAID — AVATAR MODE* ⚔️

Every Sunday 00:00 UTC, a server-wide raid boss spawns. All joined players merge into "The Avatar" — a single entity whose class, stats, and skills are determined by the participants.

*How it works:*
• Join the raid with `.g raid join`
• Each round, vote for which skill the Avatar uses (`.g raid vote 1-5`)
...
```

### UI-E5-69 — sendUsage banner-card family (16 invocations)
- **Loc:** `core/engine.js:19404 (NSFW), 19549 (IMAGE), 19673 (AUDIO), 20138 (ROAST), 20243 (SCALE), 20340 (8-BALL), 20424 (SHIP), 20867 (DEFINE), 20950 (RATE), 21234 (WEATHER), 21327 (TRANSLATE), 21407 (CRYPTO), 21584 (QR), 21629 (URL SHORTENER), 21676 (GITHUB), 22307 (DUEL)`
- **Trigger:** each command invoked with no/invalid args
- **Type:** menu (usage card)
- **Banner:** **GET_BANNER box** via `sendUsage()` (helper at engine.js:2573-2587)
- **Template:**
```
GET_BANNER(title) + `\n\n`
`📖 *Description:* ${description}\n\n`
`▫️ *Usage:* \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} ${usage}\`\n`
`▫️ *Example:* \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} ${example}\``
```
- **Example render** (for `.j ship` with no args):
```
┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
┃   ❤️ SHIP
┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

📖 *Description:* Check the compatibility between two people!

▫️ *Usage:* `.j ship @u1 @u2`
▫️ *Example:* `.j ship @friend1 @friend2`
```
- **Notes:** full invocation table (title / usage / example / desc):
  - `🔞 NSFW` / `nsfw [count] <query>` / `nsfw 5 anime` / "Search for age-restricted content." (×2: L19404 & L19431)
  - `🔍 IMAGE` / `img [count] <query>` / `img 5 goku` / "Search and download images from the web." (×2: L19549 & L19574)
  - `🎵 AUDIO` / `audio <query>` / `audio starboy` / "Search and download any song from YouTube."
  - `🔥 ROAST` / `roast @user` / `roast @friend` / "Prepares a legendary insult based on user data."
  - `⚖️ SCALE` / `powerscale <name>` / `powerscale goku` / "Analyze character stats via VS Battles."
  - `🎱 8-BALL` / `8ball <question>` / `8ball will i be rich?` / "Ask the magic 8-ball anything!"
  - `❤️ SHIP` / `ship @u1 @u2` / `ship @friend1 @friend2` / "Check the compatibility between two people!"
  - `📖 DEFINE` / `define <word>` / `define logic` / "Get the dictionary definition of any word."
  - `⭐ RATE` / `rate <something>` / `rate anime` / "Ask the bot to rate anything from 1 to 10!"
  - `🌤️ WEATHER` / `weather <city>` / `weather Tokyo` / "Check current weather conditions for any city."
  - `🌐 TRANSLATE` / `translate <text>  _OR_  translate [target_lang] <text>` / `translate es hello (translates hello to Spanish)\n.j translate hello (translates hello to English)` / "Translate text into a target language (Default: English)."
  - `📈 CRYPTO` / `crypto <coin>` / `crypto bitcoin` / "Get the current USD price and 24h change of any cryptocurrency."
  - `🖼️ QR GENERATOR` / `qr <text_or_url>` / `qr https://google.com` / "Generate a QR code from any text or link."
  - `🔗 URL SHORTENER` / `short <url>` / `short https://github.com/BrainMell/whatsapp-bot` / "Shorten any long URL link."
  - `🐙 GITHUB SEARCH` / `git <username>` / `git BrainMell` / "Fetch statistics about any GitHub user profile."
  - `⚔️ DUEL` / `duel @user [stake]` / `duel @friend 500` / "Challenge a user to a 1v1 RPG duel! Optionally stake Zeni."
- sendUsage is the ONLY banner-consistent usage mechanism in range; every other usage message (UI-E5-20/29/33/47/51/151/153/155) is an inline `❌ Usage:` one-liner — two competing usage styles.

Finish the round first with \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} combat attack\`...` (L17934, single-quoted literal-`${}` bug) and the ABYSS help menu (L17939-17966, `🕳️ *ABYSS — ENDLESS DUNGEON* 🕳️`) plus register/level-20 gates at 17977/17981 — belong to Section 49's range but are the direct entry points for the handlers documented here.
- **L22507–22564 (after range):** `.j equip [item] [slot]`, `.j unequip <slot>`, `.j use <item>` delegate to `rpgCommands.equipItem/unequipItem/useItem` with no engine-side template; `.j economy` begins a `📊 *Global Economy Statistics*` screen at L22580 — first render line is outside this range (Section 51).

# Section 50 — Summary statistics

- **Total entries:** 155 numbered (UI-E5-01 … UI-E5-155)
- **By type:** menu 11 (incl. usage-card families) · stat-screen 15 · card 1 · list 7 · leaderboard 6 · combat-round 2 · confirm 1 · error 52 (incl. usage/permission families) · notification 34 (incl. passthrough & mass-ping) · caption 9 · progress 1 (LOVE CALCULATOR bar + LEVEL UP) · reaction family 1 · relay family 1 · misc
- **Top style inconsistencies:** (1) six single-quoted literal-`${botConfig.getPrefix()}` bugs (L18050, 18055, 18062, 18071, 18639, 18652; + L17934 just before range) that print raw `${botConfig.getPrefix()}` to users; (2) four competing usage-message styles (GET_BANNER sendUsage cards vs hand-built `❌ Usage:` one-liners vs the `18+` hand-built banner card vs PVP DUEL freeform); (3) three banner systems (GET_BANNER ┏━┓ box vs anime ╔══╗ box vs plain-bold-emoji headers); (4) missing BOT_MARKER on the entire `record` command (L21924/21938/21947) and on item/vote passthroughs; (5) divider-length drift (17 vs 18 vs 19 `━` chars) and ⚠️️ double-variation-selector typos; (6) trivia reward text says +50 XP but code grants 45.
## Section 60 — engine.js part 6 (lines 22501–27197)

- **Coverage:** lines 22501–27196 (EOF) read via 12 contiguous 400-line Read windows; boundary-spanning `.vote` handler (starts L22482) included per overlap rule. Bot context: prefix `.j`, bot name `Joker`, currency symbol `Ꞩ` (Zeni), `BOT_MARKER` = U+200B zero-width space (L1252).
- **Shared primitives:** `sendUsage()` (defined L2573, outside range) renders `GET_BANNER(title)` + `📖 *Description:* / ▫️ *Usage:* / ▫️ *Example:*`; used at 7 call sites here. Renders owned by other modules (`core/rpg/*`, wordle, tictactoe, chess, ludo, debate, gambling, guildAdventure, progressionCommands, `showGraveyard` L3141, `broadcastUpdate` L5316) are NOT templated here — only their engine.js call sites / passthroughs are inventoried.
- **Dead/dup code found:** duplicate `.claim` handler (L22687–22704 first, L23453–23471 second = unreachable); hardcoded `.jk ping` in fatal error (L27058); `${botConfig.getPrefix()}ping` missing space (L27100/L27104); unbalanced `` `` `` backticks in "register first" template (5 sites).

​Frozen Assets: ${stats.totalFrozen.toLocaleString()} ${economy.getZENI()}

​Wealth Share (Top 10%): ${stats.top10Share}%

```
(each `​` above is a literal U+200B zero-width space embedded in the source template)

- **Notes:** every label line is prefixed with an invisible U+200B (copy artifact / anti-dedup trick — invisible in WhatsApp); `Active Businesses: 0` and `Business Valuation: 0` are hardcoded dead values; sent as `BOT_MARKER + msg`.

```

```

## Section 60 — summary

- **Total entries:** 136 (UI-E6-01 … UI-E6-136). Types: error/usage-hint ~57, notification/passthrough ~24, stat-screen 7 (economy, balance×3, history×2, profile text), caption/image 6, menu 3, list 3, leaderboard 4 (incl. passthroughs), confirm ~13, progress 4, reaction/sticker/video/AI-other 10.
- **Delegated (rendered elsewhere, call site only):** economy module messages (register/daily/rob/transfer/deposit/withdraw/membership), stockMarket, investment, loans, gambling results, monsterSkills guide header, wordle, tictactoe, chess, ludo, debate, guildAdventure (vote/combat), progressionCommands (level/xptop/gptop/achievements), showGraveyard (L3141), broadcastUpdate (L5316), Go image service cards (economy/transaction/profile).
- **Style inconsistencies:** (1) 5 competing banner styles — GET_BANNER ┏┓ box, inline ┏┓ copies, ╔╗ broken boxes, ━-divider frames, plain bold/emoji headers; (2) divider lengths vary 15/17/18 `━`; (3) newline style mixes literal `\n` escapes with real multiline template literals; (4) usage errors inconsistently code-backticked (hl/crash yes; roulette/horse/lotto/rps/penalty/guess/plinko/scratch/cups/wheel no); (5) register-first template has unbalanced `` `` `` backticks and is copy-pasted at 5 sites; (6) `.jk` / `${prefix}ping` hardcodes; (7) BOT_MARKER sometimes omitted (reply() paths, ludo/debate passthroughs, name prompt, AI error).
## Section 70 — commands: rpgCommands, skillCommands, shopCommands

**Coverage:** `core/commands/rpgCommands.js` (1402 lines), `core/commands/skillCommands.js` (927 lines), `core/commands/shopCommands.js` (706 lines) — all three read in full. Every user-facing `sock.sendMessage` text/image/caption block catalogued; send-sites verified by grep sweep (58 in rpgCommands, 41 in skillCommands, 22 in shopCommands). 112 entries total.

**Delivery mechanism:** every message in these three files is sent by direct `await/return sock.sendMessage(chatId, …)` inside the module — none return a `{message}` string for engine.js to relay. The only internal relays are (a) shopCommands' `handle*()` helpers returning `{success, message}` objects consumed by `buyItem()` in the same file, and (b) verbatim passthroughs of `result.message` strings built in other modules (inventorySystem, craftingSystem, summonEggSystem, guildAdventure). No `reply()`/quoted-reply usage anywhere. engine.js invokes these handlers WITHOUT `BOT_MARKER` (zero-width space) — unlike engine-built messages, so these outputs are unmarked.

**Banner style:** `GET_BANNER`/`sendMenuWithBanner` are NEVER used in these files. Header mechanisms found: `╔══╗` boxes (skillCommands only), `┏━┓` boxes (skillCommands evolve), malformed half-boxes `━━…\nTITLE \n┗━━…` (rpgCommands equip/sources/finding/craftable), thin `────` dividers (recipes), plain/ALL-CAPS/bold text headers (rpg+shop). Divider width drifts: 13 / 15 / 16 / 19 `━` and 20 `─`. Prefix default `.j`, currency symbol `Ꞩ` (Zeni) per botConfig defaults.

### UI-C1-03 — Profile card (Go image service) caption
- **Loc:** `core/commands/rpgCommands.js:119-191` (caption built 125-180, sent 181-185)
- **Trigger:** `.j me` — fallback when node-canvas card unavailable but Go service returns a buffer
- **Type:** caption
- **Banner:** plain bold section headers `*STATS:*` / `*GEAR:*`
- **Template:**
```
let captionMsg = `👤 *Character:* ${cardData.nickname}\n`;
captionMsg += `🛡️ *Class:* ${classData?.icon || '🛡️'} ${classData?.name || 'Adventurer'}\n`;
captionMsg += `⭐ *Level:* ${sheet?.level || 1}  |  🏆 *Rank:* ${cardData.rank}\n`;
captionMsg += `💰 *Zeni:* ${getCurrency().symbol}${(economyUser?.wallet || 0).toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
captionMsg += `*STATS:*\n`;
const hpDisplay = currentHP < maxHP
  ? `❤️ HP: ${currentHP}/${maxHP} ⚠️  |  ⚔️ ATK: ${stats?.atk || 10}\n`
  : `❤️ HP: ${maxHP}  |  ⚔️ ATK: ${stats?.atk || 10}\n`;
captionMsg += `🛡️ DEF: ${stats?.def || 10}${equipStats?.def ? `+${equipStats.def}` : ''}  |  🔮 MAG: ${stats?.mag || 10}${equipStats?.mag ? `+${equipStats.mag}` : ''}\n`;
captionMsg += `💨 SPD: ${stats?.spd || 10}${equipStats?.spd ? `+${equipStats.spd}` : ''}  |  🍀 LCK: ${stats?.luck || 10}${equipStats?.luck ? `+${equipStats.luck}` : ''}\n`;
captionMsg += `💥 CRIT: ${stats?.crit || 0}%  |  🕊️ EVA: ${(stats?.evasion || 0).toFixed(1)}%\n`;
captionMsg += `\n*GEAR:*\n`;
// per equipped slot (one iteration shown):
captionEquipped.push(`${getSlotIcon(slot)} *${slotName}:* ${displayName}${rarityMark}${condLabel}`);
// else branch: captionMsg += `_None equipped_\n`;
captionMsg += `\n✨ *${cardData.statPoints} Stat Points available!*\nUse \`${getPrefix()} allocate <stat> <amount>\` to assign them.`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
👤 *Character:* Kai
🛡️ *Class:* 🔮 Archmage
⭐ *Level:* 42  |  🏆 *Rank:* A
💰 *Zeni:* Ꞩ1,250,000

*STATS:*
❤️ HP: 480/520 ⚠️  |  ⚔️ ATK: 180
🛡️ DEF: 95+12  |  🔮 MAG: 240+30
💨 SPD: 110+8  |  🍀 LCK: 75+5
💥 CRIT: 15%  |  🕊️ EVA: 7.5%

*GEAR:*
⚔️ *Main Hand:* +5 Mythril Staff ✦✦✦
⛑️ *Helmet:* Archmage Circlet 🔴 22%

✨ *3 Stat Points available!*
Use `.j allocate <stat> <amount>` to assign them.
```
- **Notes:** Image+caption+mentions. Gear rarity marks: `UNCOMMON: ' ✦', RARE: ' ✦✦', EPIC: ' ✦✦✦', LEGENDARY: ' ★', MYTHIC: ' ★★'` (L158) — a THIRD rarity-mark scheme in this fileset (cf. UI-C1-21/44 `rarityEmojis` and UI-C1-94 `RARITY_ICONS`). Durability shown only when ≤50% (`💔 *BROKEN*` / ` 🔴 22%` / ` 🟠 45%`) — no full bar (comment says bar renders inside the image). "Zeni" hardcoded in label while symbol is dynamic. Stat-points tail is conditional (`cardData.statPoints > 0`).

### UI-C1-04 — Text-only PROFILE fallback
- **Loc:** `core/commands/rpgCommands.js:193-286` (built 193-259, sent 261-279)
- **Trigger:** `.j me` — last-resort path when both image services fail
- **Type:** stat-screen
- **Banner:** plain header `👤 PROFILE` (no box)
- **Template:**
```
let msg = `👤 PROFILE\n\n`;
msg += `🎭 *${senderName}*\n`;
msg += `${classData?.icon || '🛡️'} ${classData?.name || 'Adventurer'} | 🏆 ${sheet?.adventurerRank || 'F'}-Rank\n`;
msg += `⭐ Level ${sheet?.level || 1} | 💰 ${getCurrency().symbol}${(economyUser?.wallet || 0).toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
msg += `📈 ${progressBar} ${sheet?.progressPercent || 0}%\n`;
msg += `${(sheet?.xpProgress || 0).toLocaleString()}/${(sheet?.xpForThisLevel || 100).toLocaleString()} XP\n\n`;
msg += `*STATS:*\n`;
const hpStr2 = currentHP2 < maxHP2
  ? `❤️ HP:${currentHP2}/${maxHP2}⚠️ ⚔️ ATK:${stats?.atk || 10}\n`
  : `❤️ HP:${maxHP2} ⚔️ ATK:${stats?.atk || 10}\n`;
msg += `🛡️ DEF:${stats?.def || 10}${equipStats?.def ? `+${equipStats.def}` : ''} 🔮 MAG:${stats?.mag || 10}${equipStats?.mag ? `+${equipStats.mag}` : ''}\n`;
msg += `💨 SPD:${stats?.spd || 10}${equipStats?.spd ? `+${equipStats.spd}` : ''} 🍀 LCK:${stats?.luck || 10}${equipStats?.luck ? `+${equipStats.luck}` : ''}\n`;
msg += `💥 CRIT:${stats?.crit || 0}% | 🕊️ EVA:${(stats?.evasion || 0).toFixed(1)}%\n`;
// statPoints > 0:
msg += `\n✨ *${statPts} Stat Points available!*\n`;
msg += `\`${botConfig.getPrefix()} allocate <stat> <amount>\`\n`;
// else: msg += `\n🔹 *Stat Points:* 0 _(earn more by leveling up)_\n`;
msg += `\n*GEAR:*\n`;
// per slot (one iteration shown) — durability 5-block bar:
equipped.push(`• ${getSlotIcon(slot)} *${slotName}:* ${displayName}${durStr}`);
// else: msg += `_None equipped_\n`;
msg += `📜 Quests: ${economyUser?.questsCompleted || 0}\n`;
msg += `\`${botConfig.getPrefix()} inventory\` · \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} equip\``;
```
- **Example render:**
```
👤 PROFILE

🎭 *Kai*
🔮 Archmage | 🏆 A-Rank
⭐ Level 42 | 💰 Ꞩ1,250,000

📈 [████░░░░░░] 40%
4,000/10,000 XP

*STATS:*
❤️ HP:480/520⚠️ ⚔️ ATK:180
🛡️ DEF:95+12 🔮 MAG:240+30
💨 SPD:110+8 🍀 LCK:75+5
💥 CRIT:15% | 🕊️ EVA:7.5%

✨ *3 Stat Points available!*
`.j allocate <stat> <amount>`

*GEAR:*
• ⚔️ *Main Hand:* +5 Mythril Staff (🟩🟩🟩⬜⬜ 62%)

📜 Quests: 87
`.j inventory` · `.j equip`
```
- **Notes:** Sent as PFP image + caption (or `placeholder.png` image, or plain text if no asset). Compact stats use NO pipe separator on HP/ATK line and single spaces (vs `  |  ` in UI-C1-03) — near-duplicate render logic of UI-C1-03 with drifted spacing. Progress bar = `createProgressBar()` (L624-631): `[${'█'.repeat(filled)}${'░'.repeat(empty)}]`, 10 cells, NaN-safe. Durability bar `🟩/🟨/🟥 + ⬜` (5 cells) only exists in THIS variant. Mixes `botConfig.getPrefix()` (L222, 259) with local `getPrefix()` helper elsewhere in same file.

### UI-C1-07 — Inventory (BAG) main view

msg += `\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n`;
if (totalPages > 1) {
  msg += `📄 ${hints.join(' | ')}\n`;   // hints: `Prev: \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} bag ${clampedPage - 1}\`` etc.

if (pageItems.length === 0) msg += `_No recipes found._\n\n`;
// per recipe (one iteration shown):
msg += `\n${slotIcon} *${r.name}* (\`${r.id}\`) ${rarityEmoji}${lvlStr}\n`;
msg += `📝 _${r.desc || info.description || ''}_\n`;
msg += `🛠️ *Req:* ${ingredients}\n`;   // ingredients: `${qty}x ${ingSlotIcon}${ingInfo.name}` joined ', '
msg += `────────────────────\n`;
if (searchQuery) {
  msg += `💡 *Page:* \`${getPrefix()} ${cmdName} search ${searchQuery} <page>\`\n`;
} else {
  msg += `💡 *Page:* \`${getPrefix()} ${cmdName} <page>\`\n`;
}
msg += `🔨 *Craft:* \`${getPrefix()} ${cmdName} <id>\`\n`;
msg += `📌 *Example:* \`${getPrefix()} ${cmdName} ${pageItems[0]?.id || 'refined_steel'}\``;
```
- **Example render:**
```
⚒️ *⚒️ CRAFTING* (Page 1/24)
────────────────────

⚔️ *Mythril Staff* (`mythril_staff`) 🔮 [Lvl: 20]
📝 _Amplifies resonance._
🛠️ *Req:* 1x 🔮 Arcane Wand, 5x ⛏️ Mythril Ore, 2x 🔮 Mana Crystal

────────────────────
💡 *Page:* `.j craft <page>`
🔨 *Craft:* `.j craft <id>`
📌 *Example:* `.j craft mythril_staff`
```
- **Notes:** 6 items/page; sorted rarity→level→name. `rarityEmojis` here: `MYTHIC '🌌', LEGENDARY '👑', EPIC '🔮', RARE '🔷', UNCOMMON '🟢', COMMON '⚪'` (L715-722) — clashes with shopCommands `RARITY_ICONS` (RARE 🔵, EPIC 🟣, LEGENDARY 🟠, MYTHIC 🔴, UI-C1-94) AND with the ✦/★ marks in UI-C1-03. Header line renders `⚒️ *⚒️ CRAFTING*` — titleMap values already contain the emoji and `.toUpperCase()` does not strip it, so the FORGE/CRAFT stations double-emoji (⚒️ ⚒️) while BREWING/COOKING don't. Uses thin `─` divider, unique in this fileset. cmdName swaps craft→cook/brew/forge in footers. Search footer variant embeds the raw query un-escaped.

### UI-C1-22 — Craft success: image card + passthrough caption
- **Loc:** `core/commands/rpgCommands.js:784-822` (image branch 810-817, text fallback 818-822)
- **Trigger:** `.j craft <id>` / `.j brew <id>` / `.j cook <id>` / `.j forge <id>` success (`craftingSystem.performCraft`)
- **Type:** caption
- **Banner:** n/a — caption is `result.message` authored by craftingSystem (outside this fileset)
- **Template:**
```
const imgBuf = await goService.generateTransactionCard({
  nickname, type: cardType /* 'BREW'|'COOK'|'FORGE'|'CRAFT' */,
  amount: 1, newWallet: economyUser.wallet || 0, newBank: economyUser.bank || 0,
  zeniSymbol: currency.symbol || 'Z', pfpUrl, itemName: recipe?.name || input,
  item: recipe?.name || input, details: `Crafted: ${recipe?.name || input}`,
  description: recipe?.name || input
});
await sock.sendMessage(chatId, { image: imgBuf, caption: result.message });
// fallback: await sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: result.message });
```
- **Example render:**
```
(image: transaction card PNG)
⚔️ *CRAFT SUCCESSFUL!* Refined Steel ×2 forged into …   ← body from craftingSystem, shown as caption
```
- **Notes:** Caption text is a verbatim passthrough — the actual success copy lives in `core/rpg/craftingSystem.js` (not in this audit's fileset). No mentions on the image message. Text fallback sends the identical string when the Go image service fails.

### UI-C1-51 — SKILL TREE render
- **Loc:** `core/commands/skillCommands.js:39-113` (current-class section 46-71, lineage sections 74-106, footer 108-111)
- **Trigger:** `.j skill tree` / `.j st` / `.j skilltree`
- **Type:** list (skill-tree render)
- **Banner:** `╔═══…╗` box (27 `═`) + `┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓` section boxes
- **Template:**
```
let msg = `╔═════════════════════════╗\n`;
msg += `  🌳 *SKILL TREE: ${userClass.name.toUpperCase()}*\n`;
msg += `╚═════════════════════════╝\n\n`;
msg += `${userClass.icon} *${senderName}* — Lv.${level}\n`;
msg += `📊 *Skill Points Available:* ${user.skillPoints || 0}\n\n`;
// SPECIALIZATION section:
msg += `┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓\n`;
msg += `┃  ${treeData.icon} *${treeData.name}*\n`;
// per skill (one iteration shown):
msg += `┃  ${icon} *${skill.name}*`;
if (curLevel > 0) msg += ` [${curLevel}/${skill.maxLevel}]`;
msg += `\n`;
msg += `┃     ╰─ ${skill.desc || skill.description}\n`;
if (!maxed && canLearn && (user.skillPoints || 0) > 0) {
  msg += `┃     ✨ \`${getPrefix()} skill up ${skillId}\`\n`;
}
msg += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
// lineage/heritage section (per parent class):
msg += `┏━━━ 🔰 *${parentClass.name.toUpperCase()} PATH* ━━┓\n`;
inheritedSection += `┃  ${icon} *${skill.name}* [${curLevel}/${skill.maxLevel}]\n`;
inheritedSection += `┃  ⭕ *${skill.name}* _(Inherited)_\n`;
inheritedSection += `┃     ✨ \`${getPrefix()} skill up ${skillId}\`\n`;
inheritedSection += `┃  🔒 *${skill.name}*\n`;
msg += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
msg += `💡 *Commands:*\n`;
msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} skill up <name>\` — Invest a point\n`;
msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} skill reset\` — Refund all points (cost scales with level²)\n`;
msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} abilities\` — View combat ability list`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
╔═════════════════════════╗
  🌳 *SKILL TREE: ARCHMAGE*
╚═════════════════════════╝

🔮 *Kai* — Lv.42
📊 *Skill Points Available:* 5

┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓
┃  🔥 *Inferno Mastery*
┃  ✅ *Fireball* [3/5]
┃     ╰─ Hurls a searing bolt of flame.
┃  ⭕ *Meteor*
┃     ╰─ Calls destruction from the sky.
┃     ✨ `.j skill up meteor`
┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

┏━━━ 🔰 *MAGE PATH* ━━┓
┃  ✅ *Mana Font* [2/3]
┃  🔒 *Arcane Ward*

┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

💡 *Commands:*
• `.j skill up <name>` — Invest a point
• `.j skill reset` — Refund all points (cost scales with level²)
• `.j abilities` — View combat ability list
```
- **Notes:** Only file in this section using `╔═╝` box style. `┃` side walls exist in skill lines but NOT on section header/footer lines — box is decorative fiction. Learned skill icon and MAXED skill icon are BOTH `✅` (L57 comment: "Changed to ✅ for David's style"; the ternary `maxed ? '✅' : '✅'` at L89 is literally identical branches — dead code). `⭕` = learnable now, `🔒` = locked. Skill-up hint line only rendered when points > 0 and skill not maxed. Reset cost described in prose as `level²` (superscript ² — unusual character choice).

### UI-C1-61 — SKILL UPGRADED! confirmation
- **Loc:** `core/commands/skillCommands.js:283-306` (built 286-304)
- **Trigger:** `.j skill up <name>` success
- **Type:** notification
- **Banner:** bold header `✨ *SKILL UPGRADED!*`
- **Template:**
```
const heritageNote = (foundInClassName !== userClass?.name) ? `_(${foundInClassName} Heritage)_\n` : '';
let msg = `✨ *SKILL UPGRADED!*\n\n`;
msg += heritageNote;
msg += `🌟 *${targetSkill.name}* → Lv.${newLevel}/${targetSkill.maxLevel}\n\n`;
msg += `📊 Points Remaining: ${user.skillPoints}\n\n`;
if (effect?.type === 'damage' && effect.multiplier) {
  msg += `💥 Damage: ${Math.floor(effect.multiplier * 100)}% ${effect.damageType === 'magic' ? 'MAG' : effect.damageType === 'true' ? 'TRUE' : 'ATK'}\n`;
} else if (effect?.type === 'heal') {
  msg += `💚 Healing: ${effect.value} HP\n`;
} else if (effect?.type === 'buff_self' || effect?.type === 'buff_team') {
  msg += `✨ Buff: +${effect.value || '?'}% ${effect.buffType || ''}\n`;
  if (effect.duration) msg += `⏱️ Duration: ${effect.duration} turns\n`;
}
if (newLevel === targetSkill.maxLevel) {
  msg += `\n⭐ *FULLY MASTERED!*`;
}
```
- **Example render:**
```
✨ *SKILL UPGRADED!*

_(Mage Heritage)_
🌟 *Fireball* → Lv.4/5

📊 Points Remaining: 2

💥 Damage: 180% MAG

⭐ *FULLY MASTERED!*
```
- **Example render (heal skill):**
```
✨ *SKILL UPGRADED!*

🌟 *Healing Light* → Lv.2/4

📊 Points Remaining: 4

💚 Healing: 120 HP
```
- **Notes:** Heritage note italic-in-parens only when skill came from parent class. Effect block picks ONE of damage/heal/buff lines. **Buff line here says `+${value}%` but the ABILITIES list (UI-C1-66) had this `%` removed as "misleading" (2026-08-18 fix comments) — the two screens still disagree on whether buffs are percent or flat.** `⭐ *FULLY MASTERED!*` only at max.

### UI-C1-66 — ABILITIES combat list
- **Loc:** `core/commands/skillCommands.js:439-498` (mirrored section 484-492, footer 494-496)
- **Trigger:** `.j abilities` / `.j skills`
- **Type:** list
- **Banner:** `╔═══…╗` box (29 `═` — 2 wider than skill-tree box) + `━━━ ${label} ━━━` group separators
- **Template:**
```
let msg = `╔═══════════════════════════╗\n`;
msg += `    ⚡ *ABILITIES: ${senderName}*\n`;
msg += `╚═══════════════════════════╝\n\n`;
msg += `${userClass.icon} *${userClass.name}* • ${totalCount} total abilities\n\n`;
// per class group (one iteration shown):
const label = group.isCurrentClass
    ? `${group.classIcon} *${group.className}*`
    : `${group.classIcon} _${group.className} Heritage_`;
msg += `━━━ ${label} ━━━\n`;
// per ability (one iteration shown):
msg += `*${count}.* ${animation} *${ability.name}* [Lv.${ability.level}/${ability.maxLevel}]\n`;
msg += `   ${costDisplay}${cdDisplay}\n`;
// effect detail lines (one of each family shown):
msg += `   💥 ${Math.floor(e.multiplier * 100)}% ${e.damageType === 'magic' ? 'MAG' : 'ATK'} damage\n`;
msg += `   💥 ${Math.floor(e.multiplier * 100)}% ${e.damageType === 'magic' ? 'MAG' : e.damageType === 'true' ? 'TRUE' : 'ATK'} — ALL ENEMIES\n`;
msg += `   💚 Heals ${e.value} HP${e.type === 'heal_team' ? ' (Party)' : ''}\n`;
msg += `   ✨ +${e.value} ${e.buffType || 'stats'} for ${e.duration}t\n`;
msg += `   💥 ${Math.floor((e.multiplier || 1) * 100)}% ${e.damageType === 'magic' ? 'MAG' : 'ATK'} + ${e.ccChance}% ${e.cc || 'CC'}\n`;
msg += `   ⚡ ${Math.floor((e.multiplier || 2) * 100)}% dmg (Executes <${e.threshold}% HP)\n`;
msg += `   🔹 Passive: ${e.trigger || ''}\n`;
msg += `\n`;
// mirrored skills section:
msg += `━━━ 🪞 *Mirrored Skills* ━━━\n`;
msg += `*${count}.* 🪞 *${ability.name}* _(from ${ability.sourceClass})_\n`;
msg += `   ⚡ ${Math.floor(energyCost * 1.5)} (mirrored cost)\n\n`;
msg += `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n`;
msg += `💡 \`${getPrefix()} combat ability <num>\` in battle\n`;
msg += `📊 \`${getPrefix()} skill tree\` to learn more skills`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
╔═══════════════════════════╗
    ⚡ *ABILITIES: Kai*
╚═══════════════════════════╝

🔮 *Archmage* • 6 total abilities

━━━ 🔥 *Archmage* ━━━
*1.* 🔥 *Fireball* [Lv.3/5]
   ⚡ 18 | ⏱️ CD:2
   💥 160% MAG damage

*2.* ✨ *Arcane Bulwark* [Lv.1/3]
   ✨ Passive

━━━ 🔮 _Mage Heritage_ ━━━
*3.* 💚 *Healing Light* [Lv.2/4]
   ⚡ 12
   💚 Heals 90 HP

━━━ 🪞 *Mirrored Skills* ━━━
*4.* 🪞 *Rally* _(from Knight)_
   ⚡ 15 (mirrored cost)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 `.j combat ability <num>` in battle
📊 `.j skill tree` to learn more skills
```
- **Notes:** costDisplay: `⚡ N` / `✨ Passive` / `⚡ 0` (0-cost actives fixed 2026-08-18); cdDisplay appends ` | ⏱️ CD:N`. Heritage group label italic vs current bold. Buff effect lines show FLAT values (`+15 attack for 3t`) — deliberately de-percented per fix comment, still contradicted by UI-C1-61's `+%` render. 0-cost passives show `✨ Passive` with no number. `animation` defaults `🔮`. Counting is global (1..N) across groups — matches the `<num>` used by `.j combat ability <num>`.

### UI-C1-75 — CLASS EVOLUTION path menu
- **Loc:** `core/commands/skillCommands.js:642-679`

- **Banner:** `┏━…┓` box (23 `━`): `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ / ┃  🌟 *CLASS EVOLUTION* / ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛`
- **Template:**
```
let text = `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n`;
text += `┃  🌟 *CLASS EVOLUTION*\n`;

if (evo.evolves_into && evo.evolves_into.length > 0) text += `   ⏫ Next Tier: ${nextTierNames}\n`;
if (!evo.meetsRequirements) {
  text += `   🔒 Missing: ${evo.missingRequirements.join(', ')}\n`;
} else {

}
text += `\n`;

text += `✅ *Your existing skills are PRESERVED on evolution.*\n`;
text += `You keep all learned abilities and receive bonus skill points.\n\n`;
text += `\`${getPrefix()} evolve <number>\` to choose.`;
```

`.j evolve <number>` to choose.

```
let redirectMsg = `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n`;

redirectMsg    += `Those who seek its power may instead ascend as a *Dragon Lord*, commanding the Leviathan's surviving children.\n\n`;
if (dragonLord) {
  redirectMsg += `🐉 *Dragon Lord* ${dragonLord.icon}\n`;
  redirectMsg += `_${dragonLord.desc}_\n`;
  redirectMsg += `\n*Requirements:*\n`;
  redirectMsg += `• Level ${dragonLord.requirement.level}\n`;
  redirectMsg += `• ${dragonLord.requirement.questsCompleted} quests completed\n`;
  redirectMsg += `• ${dragonLord.requirement.dragonsKilled} dragons killed\n`;

  redirectMsg += `• Trial: ${dragonLord.requirement.trialBoss.replace(/_/g, ' ')}\n\n`;
  redirectMsg += `Use \`${getPrefix()} evolve\` and pick the Dragon Lord path to begin your trial.`;
} else {
  redirectMsg += `_Dragon Lord path is being prepared. Try again soon._`;
}
```

  successMsg += `${statEmojis[stat] || '•'} ${stat.toUpperCase()}: ${val}\n`;
});
successMsg += `\n✅ *Skills Preserved!*\n`;
successMsg += `🎁 *Tier Bonus:* +${bonusPoints} Skill Points\n`;
successMsg += `📊 *Total Points Available:* ${user.skillPoints}\n\n`;
if (chosen.passive) {
  successMsg += `⚡ *New Passive — ${chosen.passive.name}:*\n`;
  successMsg += `_${chosen.passive.desc}_\n\n`;
}
successMsg += `🌳 \`${getPrefix()} skill tree\` to continue your path!`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
┃   ✨ *EVOLUTION COMPLETE!*

*Mage* ──▶ *Cryomancer* ❄️

📊 *New Base Stats:*
❤️ HP: 140
⚔️ ATK: 40
🛡️ DEF: 35
🔮 MAG: 85
💨 SPD: 45

✅ *Skills Preserved!*
🎁 *Tier Bonus:* +5 Skill Points
📊 *Total Points Available:* 12

⚡ *New Passive — Frost Aura:*
_Chills enemies each turn._

🌳 `.j skill tree` to continue your path!
```
- **Notes:** `──▶` arrow glyph. Stat list order = object key order of `chosen.stats` (not a fixed canonical order like UI-C1-09). statEmojis map duplicates rpgCommands' `getStatIcon` (identical values, re-declared locally). No wallet/HP info. Same fake-box (single `┃` line).

let msg = '🥚 *SUMMON SHOP* 🥚\n';

### UI-C1-94 — Main shop view (all/category)
- **Loc:** `core/commands/shopCommands.js:151-214` (built 163-211)
- **Trigger:** `.j shop [all|class|quest|equipment|permanent]` (default all)
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** plain header `${activeCat.icon} SHOP` + 15-`━` dividers; category quick-links block
- **Template:**
```
let msg = ``;
msg += `${activeCat.icon} SHOP\n`;
msg += `\n`;
msg += `📂 *Categories:* \n`;
// per category (one iteration shown):
msg += `${info.icon} \`${getPrefix()} shop ${key}\`\n`;
msg += `\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n`;
// per item (one iteration shown; rarity/reqLevel/slot/stats/requirement lines conditional):
msg += `${item.icon} ${rarIcon} *${item.name}*\n`;
msg += `   💰 Price: ${getZENI()}${item.cost.toLocaleString()}\n`;
if (item.rarity && item.rarity !== 'COMMON') msg += `   ${rarIcon} Rarity: *${item.rarity}*\n`;
if (item.reqLevel && item.reqLevel > 1) msg += `   📊 Requires Level *${item.reqLevel}*\n`;
if (item.slot) msg += `   📍 Slot: ${item.slot.replace('_', ' ')}\n`;
// stats: msg += `   ⚔️ Stats: ${statStr}\n`;  // statStr: `${s.toUpperCase()}${v > 0 ? '+' : ''}${v}` joined ' '
msg += `   📝 ${item.desc}\n`;
if (item.requirement) msg += `   ⚠️ ${item.requirement}\n`;
msg += `   🆔 ID: \`${item.id}\`\n\n`;
// empty category variant:
msg += `❌ No items found in this category.\n`;
msg += `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n`;
msg += `💡 *How to buy:* \n`;
msg += `Type: \`${getPrefix()} buy <id>\` or \`${getPrefix()} buy <#>\`\n`;
msg += `📌 Example: \`${getPrefix()} buy health_potion_shop\``;
```
- **Example render:**
```
🛍️ SHOP

📂 *Categories:* 
🛍️ `.j shop all`
🎭 `.j shop class`
🧪 `.j shop quest`
⚔️ `.j shop equipment`
🥚 `.j shop summon`
📈 `.j shop permanent`

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚔️ 🔵 *Frostbrand Blade*
   💰 Price: Ꞩ45,000
   🔵 Rarity: *RARE*
   📊 Requires Level *15*
   📍 Slot: main hand
   ⚔️ Stats: ATK+38 SPD+6
   📝 A blade wreathed in permafrost.
   🆔 ID: `frostbrand_blade`

🧪 ⚪ *Health Potion*
   💰 Price: Ꞩ150
   📝 Restores 80 HP.
   🆔 ID: `health_potion_shop`

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 *How to buy:* 
Type: `.j buy <id>` or `.j buy <#>`
📌 Example: `.j buy health_potion_shop`
```
- **Notes:** `RARITY_ICONS = { COMMON: '⚪', UNCOMMON: '🟢', RARE: '🔵', EPIC: '🟣', LEGENDARY: '🟠', MYTHIC: '🔴' }` (L187) — **conflicts with rpgCommands' `rarityEmojis` (RARE 🔷, EPIC 🔮, LEGENDARY 👑, MYTHIC 🌌) AND its RARITY_MARK (✦/★)** — three rarity color-codes across the fileset. Category list printed on EVERY category page (even when viewing one category). No pagination — `all` dumps every buyable item in one message (potential WhatsApp length overflow). Trailing space after `📂 *Categories:* ` and `💡 *How to buy:* ` in source. Category quick-links use inline-code `\`.j shop key\``; summon link shown in the category block even though its view is rendered separately. MYTHIC shop price is silently 1.35× base (shopPrice fn L27-33) — price shown is the marked-up cost.

---

## Section summary

**Entry count:** 112 (rpgCommands.js 49 → UI-C1-01…49; skillCommands.js 42 → UI-C1-50…91; shopCommands.js 21 → UI-C1-92…112).

**By type:** error 63 · notification 22 · list 9 · caption 4 · menu 5 · stat-screen 3 · leaderboard 2 · other/passthrough 4.

**Cross-file style inconsistencies (highlights):**
1. Three conflicting rarity icon schemes: shop `RARITY_ICONS` (RARE 🔵 / EPIC 🟣 / LEGENDARY 🟠 / MYTHIC 🔴) vs rpg `rarityEmojis` (RARE 🔷 / EPIC 🔮 / LEGENDARY 👑 / MYTHIC 🌌) vs gear `RARITY_MARK` (✦✦✦ / ★★).
2. Five banner families in three files: `╔═╝` boxes, `┏━┓` boxes (2 widths + misaligned Leviathan 30-wide), fake half-boxes `━━/┗━` (13 & 16 wide), thin `─` dividers (20), plain headers — never `GET_BANNER`. Divider length drift: 13/15/16/19 `━`.
3. Prefix-spacing bugs: `${getPrefix()}use` / `${getPrefix()}enhance` render as `.juse` / `.jenhance` (UI-C1-34/37) while all other hints insert a space; summon shop hardcodes literal `.summon eggcraft`.
4. Registration errors in 6 phrasings; funds errors in 4 layouts; two durability formats + three stat-label spellings (`LUCK` vs `LCK`, `STATS:` block layouts differ per screen).
5. Multi-line strings via `\n` template escapes everywhere except two real-newline literals (UI-C1-103/104) and one `+`-concatenation (UI-C1-47); SUMMON SHOP entirely `+`-concatenated single quotes.
6. `**double bold**` typo in trial message (UI-C1-85); missing closing backtick in bag footer `use <#>` hint (UI-C1-07); dead `.skill unmirror` hint (UI-C1-70); duplicated CRAFT SUCCESSFUL builder (UI-C1-49) and 5 duplicated profile-card renderers.
## Section 75 — commands: summonCommands, classCommands

- **Files covered:** `core/commands/summonCommands.js` (2221 lines, 148 `sock.sendMessage` sites → 112 entries after merging identical-repeat variants), `core/commands/classCommands.js` (142 lines, 3 send sites → 3 entries). Read in full via offset windows.
- **Delivery mechanism:** every user-facing text in both files is sent by **direct `sock.sendMessage` inside the module**. engine.js:8662 calls `summonCommands.handleCommand(...)` for `.j summon|summons <args>` and returns; engine.js:8394/11127/11136 call `classCommands.displayClasses/displayEvolutionTree` directly. Neither module returns a `result.message` to the caller — but 15 entries below **relay another module's `result.message`** (summonSystem, summonEggSystem, summonForging, summonTrials, summonEvolution, summonSkillTrees, pvpSystem, altDetection, inventorySystem); those templates are owned by those files' sections.
- **Prefix:** `botConfig.getPrefix()` → `.j` (botConfig.js:13). Roster/detail/codex have 3-tier render fallbacks: Go-service GIF→ffmpeg MP4 (`video`+`gifPlayback`) → node-canvas PNG (`image`) → text.

### UI-C2-71 — Duel usage / help screen
- **Loc:** `core/commands/summonCommands.js:1548-1552`
- **Trigger:** `.j summon duel` with no @mention or reply target (cmdDuel)
- **Type:** error (usage/help hybrid)
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
❌ Usage: `${getPrefix()} summon duel @user [wager]`

Challenge another player's active summon to a real turn-based duel. Both players must have a summon deployed.

After challenging, the target uses `${getPrefix()} accept` to accept. Then both players take turns using:
  • `${getPrefix()} combat attack` — basic attack
  • `${getPrefix()} combat ability <n>` — use an ability
  • `${getPrefix()} combat item` — use a Summon Healing Pill
  • `${getPrefix()} combat flee` — forfeit (loyalty penalty)

💡 You can also reply to a player's message and run `${getPrefix()} summon duel` to target them.
```
- **Example render:**
```
❌ Usage: `.j summon duel @user [wager]`

Challenge another player's active summon to a real turn-based duel. Both players must have a summon deployed.

After challenging, the target uses `.j accept` to accept. Then both players take turns using:
  • `.j combat attack` — basic attack
  • `.j combat ability <n>` — use an ability
  • `.j combat item` — use a Summon Healing Pill
  • `.j combat flee` — forfeit (loyalty penalty)

💡 You can also reply to a player's message and run `.j summon duel` to target them.
```
- **Notes:** Indented `•` bullets with 2-space prefix (unique in file). Documents reply-to targeting (FIX 2026-08-05). Direct send.

### UI-C2-75 — Skill tree help menu

Each summon has a 3-path skill tree. Choose ONE path and unlock nodes as you level up.

### UI-C2-112 — Summon help mega-menu
- **Loc:** `core/commands/summonCommands.js:2161-2211`
- **Trigger:** `.j summon help` OR any unknown `.j summon <sub>` (cmdHelp via router default L178-179)
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** plain bold `🐉 *SUMMONER SYSTEM*` + `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━` divider
- **Template:**
```
🐉 *SUMMONER SYSTEM*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

*COMMANDS:*
📋 `${p} summons` — view your Main Deck (animated)
📦 `${p} summon backlog` — view your Backlog summons
🔄 `${p} summon swap <backlog#> <deckSlot>` — swap between Backlog and Main Deck
🔍 `${p} summon <#>` — view summon details (animated)
⚔️ `${p} summon <#> deploy` — deploy summon for combat (1 at a time)
🛡️ `${p} summon dismiss` — unequip active summon
📈 `${p} summon train <#>` — daily training (+500 XP)
📊 `${p} summon allocate <#> <stat> <pts>` — allocate stat points
🛤️ `${p} summon skill <#>` — view/manage skill tree
🔗 `${p} summon resonance` — view active resonance bonuses
📚 `${p} summon codex` — view ALL summon species (5 per page)
🥚 `${p} summon hatch <egg_id>` — hatch a summon egg
💎 `${p} summon eggcraft <tier>` — craft eggs from fragments
⚔️ `${p} summon forge <#1> <#2>` — Soul Forge two summons
🏆 `${p} summon trial <#>` — attempt evolution trial
✨ `${p} summon passives` — view unlocked trial passives
🏪 `${p} summon market <list/sell/buy/cancel>` — summon trading
⚔️ `${p} summon duel @user` — summon vs summon PvP
💔 `${p} summon release <#>` — permanently release a summon

*MAIN DECK & BACKLOG:*
• Main Deck = 3 slots (deployable in combat)
• Backlog = unlimited storage for extra summons
• Use `${p} summon swap <backlog#> <deckSlot>` to move summons
• Example: `${p} summon swap 1 2` = backlog #1 → deck slot 2

*OBTAINING SUMMONS:*
• 🥚 Buy a *Basic Summon Egg* from the shop (5K Zeni) → hatches 1 of 4 starters
• 🐉 Explore the *Abyss* — 10% chance per floor to encounter a Wild Summon
• 💎 Defeat Wild Summons → drop *Summon Fragments* (tiered by floor depth)
• 🔮 Craft higher-tier eggs from fragments → hatch stronger summons
• Necromancer: cast Army of the Dead to capture enemies
• Buy from other players on the summon market

*EGG CRAFTING:*
• 10x Common Fragment → Rare Egg
• 10x Rare Fragment → Epic Egg
• 10x Epic Fragment → Legendary Egg
• 10x Legendary Fragment → Mythic Egg

*MECHANICS:*
• Summons act via gauge-based turn order (high SPD = more turns)
• Personalities shift based on how you use them
• Death leaves a Soul Echo buff on you (3 turns)
• Loyalty decays per action — restore with Loyalty Crystals
• Own diverse summons to activate Resonance Web bonuses
• At 0 loyalty: 5% betrayal chance per combat

💡 Use partial IDs (last 8 chars) or nicknames for <id>.
```

### UI-C3-05 — GM admin console: FULL GUIDE (help)
- **Loc:** `core/commands/adminConsole.js:221-364`
- **Trigger:** `.g admin` / `.g admin help` / `.g mod help` / `.g modcom help` (aliases: mod/admin/modcom)
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** plain bold header + `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━` (19×━) section dividers; NO GET_BANNER box, no banner.png image
- **Template:** (full literal; one long template-literal concatenation)
```
🎛️ *GM ADMIN CONSOLE — FULL GUIDE*

_Mod-only RPG moderation toolkit. RPG Mods, Global Mods, and Owner only._

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 *HOW TO TARGET PLAYERS*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
All commands accept a target. 3 ways to specify:
1️⃣ **@mention** — tag the player: `${prefix} admin setlevel @friend 50`
2️⃣ **Reply** — reply to their message: `${prefix} admin setlevel 50`
3️⃣ **Self** — no mention/reply = targets YOU: `${prefix} admin setlevel 50`

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👤 *PLAYER MANAGEMENT*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• `${prefix} admin setlevel <@user> <1-100>`
  Sets level directly. Recalculates XP + grants stat points.
  Example: `${prefix} admin setlevel 75` (sets YOUR level to 75)

• `${prefix} admin setstat <@user> <stat> <value>`
  Sets an individual stat (hp, atk, def, mag, spd, luck, crit).
  Example: `${prefix} admin setstat @friend hp 5000`

• `${prefix} admin setwallet <@user> <amount>`
  Sets wallet balance directly (overwrites current).
  Example: `${prefix} admin setwallet 1000000`

• `${prefix} admin giveitem <@user> <item_name> [qty]`
  Gives items by name (resolves automatically). Default qty = 1.
  Example: `${prefix} admin giveitem @friend legendary_enhancement_stone 10`

• `${prefix} admin takeitem <@user> <item_name> [qty]`
  Removes items from inventory.

• `${prefix} admin giveskill <@user> <skill_name> [level]`
  Grants any skill regardless of class/level requirements.
  Example: `${prefix} admin giveskill @friend meteor 3`

• `${prefix} admin revokeskill <@user> <skill_name>`
  Removes a skill from the player.

• `${prefix} admin resetplayer <@user>`
  Resets all stats to 0 and revokes all skills. Refunds stat points.
  Keeps level, wallet, and items.

• `${prefix} admin forceevolve <@user> <class_name>`
  Force-evolves to any class, bypassing all requirements.
  Example: `${prefix} admin forceevolve @friend Warlord`

• `${prefix} admin givepoints <@user> <amount>`
  Grants STAT points (for HP/ATK/DEF allocation).

• `${prefix} admin setskillpoints <@user> <amount>`
  Sets RPG SKILL points directly (for ability tree).

• `${prefix} admin giveskillpoints <@user> <amount>`
  Adds RPG SKILL points (does NOT overwrite).

• `${prefix} admin fightenemy <bossId|name>`
  Fight any boss for testing. Use `admin enemy list` to find IDs.

• `${prefix} admin givezeni <@user> <amount>`
  Adds Zeni to wallet (does NOT overwrite — adds to existing).

• `${prefix} admin setrank <@user> <F|E|D|C|B|A|S|SS|SSS|GOD>`
  Sets adventurer rank directly.

• `${prefix} admin unstick <@user>`
  Clears stuck combat state (pendingActions, combatProcessing).
  Use when someone is locked out of combat.

• `${prefix} admin inspect <@user>`
  Full character inspection: stats, equipment, skills, wallet, rank.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔧 *CONTENT TOOLS*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• `${prefix} admin createskill`
  Sends a fill-in-the-blank template. Reply to it with the filled
  version to create a real skill in the skill tree.

• `${prefix} admin createclass`
  Same template pattern for creating a new class.

• `${prefix} admin disableskill <skill_name>`
  Disables a skill (players can't learn it, equipped ones no-op).

• `${prefix} admin enableskill <skill_name>`
  Re-enables a disabled skill.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👹 *ENEMY EDITOR (NEW)*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• `${prefix} admin enemy list`
  Lists all bosses with HP/ATK/DEF/XP/Gold.

• `${prefix} admin enemy info <bossId>`
  Full stat block for one boss. Use list to find IDs.

• `${prefix} admin enemy setstat <bossId> <stat> <value>`
  Edit any stat (hp/atk/def/mag/spd/luck/crit). Applies immediately.

• `${prefix} admin enemy sethp|setatk|setdef <bossId> <value>`
  Shortcuts for the most-edited stats.

• `${prefix} admin enemy setxp <bossId> <value>`
  Set XP reward.

• `${prefix} admin enemy setgold <bossId> <min> <max>`
  Set gold reward range.

• `${prefix} admin enemy reset`
  Discards all runtime edits, reloads from source.

_Edits are in-memory only — a restart reverts them. For permanent changes, edit classEncounters.js._
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚡ *ENEMY SKILL EDITOR (NEW)*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• `${prefix} admin enemyskills [archetype]`
  Lists all 63 monster skills across 12 archetypes with IDs.

• `${prefix} admin enemyskill info <archetype> <skillId>`
  Full skill details (cost, level req, type, chain).

• `${prefix} admin enemyskill setcost <arch> <skillId> <value>`
  Edit skill mana cost.

• `${prefix} admin enemyskill setlevel <arch> <skillId> <level>`
  Edit skill level requirement.

• `${prefix} admin enemyskill setname <arch> <skillId> <name>`
  Edit skill display name.

• `${prefix} admin enemyskill reset`
  Reload all monster skills from source.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧪 *SANDBOX MODE (FULL RPG TESTING)*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Fully stacked test character — Lv100, GOD rank, 1B Zeni, all trials done.
When ON, ALL your commands use the sandbox account. Your real account is safe.

*CORE:*
• `${prefix} admin sandbox on` — activate (swap to sandbox character)
• `${prefix} admin sandbox off` — deactivate (save + restore real account)
• `${prefix} admin sandbox` — show status (active/inactive + stats)
• `${prefix} admin sandbox save` — save sandbox data without turning off
• `${prefix} admin sandbox reset` — wipe to fresh stacked state

*COMBAT:*
• `${prefix} admin godmode on/off` — 99999 dmg per hit, 0 dmg taken
• `${prefix} admin sandbox fightboss <bossId>` — fight any boss

*CLASS & SKILLS:*
• `${prefix} admin sandbox evolve <class>` — switch to ANY class + unlock all skills
• `${prefix} admin sandbox giveskillsall` — unlock ALL skills from ALL classes
• `${prefix} admin sandbox giveskill <skill> [level]` — grant a specific skill

*STATS:*
• `${prefix} admin sandbox maxstats` — set all stats to 99999/9999
• `${prefix} admin sandbox setlevel <1-100>`
• `${prefix} admin sandbox setrank <F-SSS|GOD>`
• `${prefix} admin sandbox setstat <stat> <value>`

*ECONOMY:*
• `${prefix} admin sandbox setwallet <amount>`
• `${prefix} admin sandbox givezeni <amount>`

*INVENTORY:*
• `${prefix} admin sandbox giveall` — grant 99× all stones, keys + every equipment
• `${prefix} admin sandbox giveitem <item> [qty]`
• `${prefix} admin sandbox clearinv` — clear sandbox inventory
• `${prefix} admin sandbox unequipall` — unequip all equipment
• `${prefix} admin sandbox setclass <name>`

_Auto-saves after every command. Data persists in separate DB collection._
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎭 *MAIN-ACCOUNT CLASS SWITCH*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• `${prefix} modclass <class_name>`
  Switches YOUR class freely (bypasses evolution requirements).
  All other stats/items/progress unchanged.
  Example: `${prefix} modclass Archmage`
  Use `${prefix} modclass` (no args) to see all available classes.

_Non-mods cannot use any of these commands._
```
- **Example render:** same as template with `${prefix}` → `.g` (excerpt):
```
🎛️ *GM ADMIN CONSOLE — FULL GUIDE*

_Mod-only RPG moderation toolkit. RPG Mods, Global Mods, and Owner only._

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 *HOW TO TARGET PLAYERS*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
All commands accept a target. 3 ways to specify:
1️⃣ **@mention** — tag the player: `.g admin setlevel @friend 50`
...
```
- **Notes:** Direct `sock.sendMessage`, `BOT_MARKER` (ZWSP) prefix. **This is the critical v3 baseline menu** — plain-bold + ━ divider style, NOT the GET_BANNER box / sendMenuWithBanner image used by main menu. Help drift: does NOT document `admin give`/`additem` (smart give), `admin givesummon`, `admin giverune` — all live subcommands. Section order fixed; sandbox `fightboss` documented but handler is broken (see UI-C3-115). Built by ~140 concatenated template segments (backtick-per-line style, vs `msg +=` style used elsewhere in same file).

- **Loc:** `core/commands/adminConsole.js:976-992` (builder L978-991)
- **Trigger:** `.g admin enemy list` / `.g admin enemy list <pool>` / `.g admin enemy`
- **Type:** list
- **Banner:** plain bold `👹 *BOSS REGISTRY*`; per-pool `━ *${pool}* (N bosses) ━` mini-headers
- **Template:** (loops trimmed to one pool / one boss)
```
👹 *BOSS REGISTRY*

━ *${pool}* (${BOSS_ENCOUNTERS[pool].length} bosses) ━
  • ${boss.icon} *${boss.name}* — `${boss.id}`
    ❤️ ${boss.stats.hp} | ⚔️ ${boss.stats.atk} | 🛡️ ${boss.stats.def}
    ⭐ XP ${boss.xpReward} | 💰 ${boss.goldReward?.[0] || 0}-${boss.goldReward?.[1] || 0}

_Edit with: `${prefix} admin enemy setstat <bossId> <stat> <value>`_
_Reset all edits: `${prefix} admin enemy reset`_
```
- **Example render:**
```

━ *WASTELAND* (6 bosses) ━
  • 🐉 *Ancient Dragon* — `ANCIENT_DRAGON_BOSS`
    ❤️ 92000 | ⚔️ 6100 | 🛡️ 3300
    ⭐ XP 48000 | 💰 30000-45000

_Edit with: `.g admin enemy setstat <bossId> <stat> <value>`_
_Reset all edits: `.g admin enemy reset`_
```
- **Notes:** Direct send; `msg +=` builder. Full unfiltered list dumps EVERY pool (~40+ bosses) in one message — no pagination; WhatsApp 65,536-char limit risk. `poolFilter` arg (L977/981) is effectively dead: filter only matches when arg equals a pool name, but `enemySub` consumes args[1] as the subcommand so `enemy list <pool>` never passes the intended pool (list-vs-filter arg collision).

## Coverage notes / gaps

- **adminConsole.js — 214 send sites → 124 entries.** Grouped families (identical strings, values differ only): one-line usage errors (32 sites, UI-C3-06), "User not found." (13, 07), "Skill not found." (4, 33), "Class not found." (3, 38), "Boss not found." (5, 53), "Skill not found in archetype." (4, 62), skill-not-in-tree (2, 47), add-item failure (2, 15), give summon/rune exception (4, 18), rune relay (2, 19), reset-failed (3, 52), sandbox-not-active long (3, 81) / short (4, 91), sandbox user not found (5, 92), generic `❌ Failed:` catch (12, 93), parse errors (2, 120). Every distinct template (incl. all success cards, menus, screens, templates, redirects, unknown-subcommand fallbacks) has its own entry. NOT counted as UI: console.error logs (L168, L295), DB writes, dead `sendLive`/`editLive` helpers (L187-199, never called — noted under UI-C3-86).
- **Caller-side gates cataloged from engine.js** (UI-C3-123/124) because adminConsole.js itself contains NO permission checks; without them the console catalog would be missing its only denial messages.
- **repairCommands.js — 14 entries** — every branch incl. empty states, image-caption and text-fallback variants of inspect.
- **progressionCommands.js — 25 entries** — every branch; 4 entries flagged DEAD (`handleCommandReward` LEVEL UP UI-C3-139; `handleRankCommand` UI-C3-151/152 — handlers exported but never dispatched by live engine.js; only .bak-* copies call them).
- NOT in scope of these files (live in other modules, referenced only): guildAdventure trial-battle renderings relayed by fightenemy (UI-C3-72), progression.js `result.message` strings relayed by allocate (UI-C3-155), GO profile-card image itself (UI-C3-137), COMMAND_REGISTRY help categories, `summon codex` / `rune types` / `skill tree` targets pointed to by various tips.
# Section 85 — rpg: cardSystem, itemMarket

**Coverage summary:**
- `core/rpg/cardSystem.js` (4,767 lines) read in full (offset windows 1–4768); `core/rpg/itemMarket.js` (254 lines) read in full. 107 UI entries below.
- **How text reaches the user (both files):** cardSystem constructs its own `reply` closure at `cardSystem.js:3754` — `const reply = (text, options = {}) => inst.sock_ref.sendMessage(chatId, { text, ...options });` — i.e. **every `reply()` in cardSystem AND itemMarket is a DIRECT `sock.sendMessage`** (itemMarket receives this same closure via the router dispatch at 4002–4020). Media renders bypass `reply()` and call `inst.sock_ref.sendMessage(chatId, { image|video, caption })` directly. Functions returning `{ success, message }` (setSpawnInterval, setTierConfig, resetTierConfig, start/stopTokenEvent, eshopAddCard/Remove/SetPrice, eshopBuy) are relayed by cardSystem's own router via `reply(result.message)` — still a direct send, NOT an engine.js `result.message` passthrough. engine.js only touches cardSystem for mod-role sync (11862+, calls to unexported `getInst/saveRoles/loadRoles` that silently fail in try/catch — dead, engine-side). No `sendMenuWithBanner` / GET_BANNER usage anywhere in these two files.
- Shared style: WhatsApp bold `*…*`, italics `_…_`, inline code `` `…` ``; dividers drift between `━`×15, `━`×18, `▬`×11, `▬`×16, `═`×17 boxes.

### UI-CD-02 — formatTierConfig block (embedded config list)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/cardSystem.js:542-555`
- **Trigger:** `.spawnset tier show|reset`, `.spawnset tier <t> <type> <v>` success, `.spawninfo`
