  T${t}: ${status}
```
where `status` is `weight=${w}`, `chance=${(c * 100).toFixed(2)}%`, both joined by `, `, or `disabled` (tiers S,E,1,2,3,4,5,6 in that order, joined `\n`)

Interpolated sub-blocks: `copyInfo` = `\n📋  *Copy:* #${uc.copyNumber} / ${stat?.maxCopies || '?'}`; `ownerTag` = `\n👤  *Owner:* @${economy.getDisplayName(uc.userId)}`; `eventLine` = `\n🎪  *Event:* ${card.eventName || card.animeName}`; `descLine` = `\n📝  *Description:* ${card.description}`. ### UI-CD-05 — doSpawn media send (animated vs static spawn) ⭐ CRITICAL #1
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/cardSystem.js:794-807`
- **Trigger:** spawn tick / `.spawn <name>` / `.espawn` / `.cards on`
- **Type:** notification (image/video message)
- **Banner:** none (caption carries it — UI-CD-04)
- **Template:**
```
// T6 / S / event cards:
await inst.sock_ref.sendMessage(targetGroup, { video: gifBuffer, gifPlayback: true, caption });
// fallback if GIF conversion fails, and ALL other tiers:
await inst.sock_ref.sendMessage(targetGroup, { image: Buffer.from(res.data), caption, mimetype: 'image/jpeg' });
```
- **Example render:** T6 card → animated MP4/GIF message "playing" inline with the CARD APPEARED! caption; T1–T5 → static JPEG with same caption.
- **Notes:** The ONLY place a spawn is announced. Animated-vs-static branch: `String(card.tier) === '6' || String(card.tier) === 'S' || isEventCard(card)` → `goService.convertCardImage()` video; conversion failure silently degrades to static JPEG (799-803). Same tri-condition duplicated at 1578, 1700, 2241, 2275, 2306, 3478, 4216 — 7 copies of the "is this card animated?" logic. On send failure the spawn is rolled back silently (823-826) — user sees nothing.

### UI-CD-93 — spawnset tier help
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/cardSystem.js:4244-4259`
- **Trigger:** `.spawnset tier` (no tier arg)
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
🔧 *Tier Spawn Configuration*

Usage:
• `${p} spawnset tier <T1-T6|S|E> weight <0-100>` — set weighted pool weight (0 = disabled)
• `${p} spawnset tier <T5|T6|S|E> chance <0.0-1.0>` — set per-spawn chance (0 = disabled)
• `${p} spawnset tier reset` — reset to defaults
• `${p} spawnset tier show` — view current config

Examples:
• `${p} spawnset tier S chance 0.05` — 5% chance per spawn for S-tier
• `${p} spawnset tier 5 weight 5` — T5 in weighted pool with weight 5
• `${p} spawnset tier S chance 0` — disable S-tier spawns

_T1-T4 use weights only. T5/T6/S/E can use both weight and chance._
```
- **Example render:** shown above with `.spawnset tier …` bullets.
- **Notes:** `show` sub renders `📊 *Tier Spawn Config — ${botConfig.getBotId()}*\n\n${formatTierConfig(getInst())}` (4266).

### UI-CD-94 — spawnset interval help
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/cardSystem.js:4285-4301`
- **Trigger:** `.spawnset` (no args)
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
🔧 *Spawn Interval Configuration*

Usage:
• `${p} spawnset <minutes>` — set fixed interval (1 to 1440 min)
• `${p} spawnset <min>-<max>` — random interval within range (e.g. `15-30`)
• `${p} spawnset reset` — restore default (20 min)
• `${p} spawnset tier <...>` — tier spawn weights/chances (unchanged)
• `${p} spawninfo` — view current settings

Examples:
• `${p} spawnset 20` → fixed 20 min (default, 3 spawns/hour)
• `${p} spawnset 15-30` → random 15-30 min (avg ~4 spawns/hour)
• `${p} spawnset 10-45` → random 10-45 min (more varied)
• `${p} spawnset 60` → fixed 1 spawn/hour

_Random ranges make spawns feel less predictable to players.
_Interval is shared across all bot instances and persists across restarts._
```
- **Example render:** shown above.
- **Notes:** Note the malformed trailing italics: two lines both begin with `_` but only the last closes — `_Random ranges … players.\n_Interval is … restarts._` renders as literal stray underscore on line 1 in WhatsApp (italic runs per line: line 1 opens italic never closes → WhatsApp auto-closes at newline; line 2 is properly wrapped). Copy bug.

## Section 90 — rpg: skillTree, classSystem, classEncounters, runeSystem, runeSynergies, weaponSynergy

**Coverage summary (3 lines):**
- All 6 assigned files read end-to-end (skillTree.js 6,041 ln; classSystem.js 1,388 ln; classEncounters.js 1,490 ln; runeSystem.js 1,131 ln; runeSynergies.js 321 ln; weaponSynergy.js 129 ln — 10,500 ln total).
- KEY STRUCTURAL FINDING: **none of these 6 modules builds a display string directly** (except runeSystem.js error/result messages and runeSynergies' dead SYNERGY banner). They are DATA + LOGIC modules; every screen below is a *data-driven* UI whose layout lives in consumers: `core/commands/skillCommands.js`, `core/commands/classCommands.js`, `core/commands/shopCommands.js`, `core/engine.js` (`.g/.j rune` block L17352-17738, `.j rank` L11150-11231), `core/rpg/guildAdventure.js` (combat log, boss splash), `core/rpg/combatIntegration.js` (battle captions) and `core/rpg/bossMechanics.js` (phase messages). Entries are anchored at the assigned-file data (`Loc`) with the consumer render site quoted verbatim as the Template, so every string is grep-verifiable in both places.
- 26 entries below. The "visually praised" skill-tree layout conventions (header box, ┏━✨ banner, ┃ node lines, ╰─ desc, footer) are catalogued in extra detail in UI-SK-01/02.

> Relay path notes used throughout: `skillCommands.js`/`classCommands.js` call `sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: msg })` directly (no banner image); `engine.js` sends `BOT_MARKER + result.message` for rune ops; classEncounters data renders via guildAdventure combat-log sends. None of these screens use `GET_BANNER()` or `sendMenuWithBanner()` — they roll their own box headers (drift documented per entry).

## A. core/rpg/skillTree.js (data: 45 classes, 56 branches, 272 skills; layout in skillCommands.js)

Data stats (verified by loading the module): 45 class keys, 56 branch trees, 272 skills. 35 skills use the **legacy schema** (`desc:`, `cost:`, `requires: {skill:lvl}`, `effect: (level)=>({...})` — the 4 starter classes); 237 use the **structured schema** (`description:`, `energyCost: [...]`, `skillPointCost: [...]`, `prerequisite: [...]`, `damageMultiplier: [...]`, `targeting:`). 24 skills declare `requires`, 40 declare `prerequisite` — but `canLearnSkill()` (skillTree.js:5783-5793) only reads `requires`, so the 40 structured `prerequisite` chains are NEVER enforced in the learn/upgrade gate (audit bug). `trees[].color` exists on only 12 of 56 branches (starters only) and is not rendered anywhere.

### UI-SK-01 — Skill Tree screen (current class, SPECIALIZATION view) — `.j skill tree` / `.g skill tree`
- **Loc:** data `core/rpg/skillTree.js:13-5585` (SKILL_TREES); layout `core/commands/skillCommands.js:39-113` (displaySkillTree)
- **Trigger:** `.j skill tree` / `.g skill tree` / `.j skills` (skillCommands.displaySkillTree)
- **Type:** stat-screen / menu
- **Banner:** double-box header — outer `╔═══...═╗` full-width box (25 `═`) wrapping `  🌳 *SKILL TREE: <CLASS>*`, then per-section `┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓` banner. NOT GET_BANNER.
- **Template:**
```
    let msg = `╔═════════════════════════╗\n`;
    msg += `  🌳 *SKILL TREE: ${userClass.name.toUpperCase()}*\n`;
    msg += `╚═════════════════════════╝\n\n`;
    msg += `${userClass.icon} *${senderName}* — Lv.${level}\n`;
    msg += `📊 *Skill Points Available:* ${user.skillPoints || 0}\n\n`;
        msg += `┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓\n`;
            msg += `┃  ${treeData.icon} *${treeData.name}*\n`;
                msg += `┃  ${icon} *${skill.name}*`;
                if (curLevel > 0) msg += ` [${curLevel}/${skill.maxLevel}]`;
                msg += `\n`;
                msg += `┃     ╰─ ${skill.desc || skill.description}\n`;
                    msg += `┃     ✨ \`${getPrefix()} skill up ${skillId}\`\n`;
        msg += `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n`;
    msg += `💡 *Commands:*\n`;
    msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} skill up <name>\` — Invest a point\n`;
    msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} skill reset\` — Refund all points (cost scales with level²)\n`;
    msg += `• \`${getPrefix()} abilities\` — View combat ability list`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
╔═════════════════════════╗
  🌳 *SKILL TREE: WARRIOR*
╚═════════════════════════╝

⚔️ *Kai* — Lv.24
📊 *Skill Points Available:* 6

┏━━━✨ *SPECIALIZATION* ━━━┓
┃  ⚔️ *Warrior Combat*
┃  ✅ *Shield Bash* [3/5]
┃     ╰─ Bash enemy with shield, scaling stun chance
┃     ✨ `.j skill up shield_bash`
┃  🔒 *Execute*
┃     ╰─ Massive damage, instant kill if target below threshold HP
┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

💡 *Commands:*
• `.j skill up <name>` — Invest a point
• `.j skill reset` — Refund all points (cost scales with level²)
• `.j abilities` — View combat ability list
```
- **Notes:** Style conventions of the praised tree UI (all verbatim from skillCommands.js:39-111):
  - **Header/banner mechanism:** outer box uses `╔/╚` double-line corners (25 `═`), title indented 2 spaces, class name ALL-CAPS via `.toUpperCase()`, 🌳 emoji. Per-section banner switches glyph family to `┏/┗` thin boxes with a `✨` mid-title decoration and unbalanced `━━━` runs (3 before, 4 after `SPECIALIZATION`).
  - **Branch nesting:** branches (`tree.trees`) are flat under the section banner — each branch prints one `┃  ${icon} *${name}*` line, then its skills immediately (no sub-banner per branch; nesting depth = 2 levels visual via `┃` gutter).
  - **Node lines:** `┃  <state-icon> *Name* [cur/max]` — state icons: `🔒` locked, `✅` learned (maxed AND in-progress use the SAME ✅ — line 57-58 `if (maxed) icon='✅'; else if (curLevel>0) icon='✅'`, a deliberate "David's style" change noted in a comment), `⭕` learnable-with-points. `[cur/max]` only printed when curLevel>0, so brand-new learnable skills show no level.
  - **Desc line:** `┃     ╰─ ${skill.desc || skill.description}` — tree-branch connector `╰─` under 5 spaces, supports both schema field names.
  - **Affordance line:** `┃     ✨ \`.j skill up <skillId>\`` printed only when learnable AND points > 0.
  - **Footer:** `┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛\n\n` then plain `💡 *Commands:*` bullet list with backticked commands — no box, `━`-free.
  - Per-class data table (one row per class; 45 classes; sample rows): `FIGHTER | ⚔️ | 3 branches (Offensive Stance ⚔️🔴/Defensive Stance 🛡️🔵/Combat Mastery ⚡🟡) | 9 skills`; `WARRIOR | ⚔️ | 1 branch (Warrior Combat) | 7 skills, ultimate: Execute ⚔️💀`; `DRAGON_GOD | 🐲👑 | 2 branches (Dragon Power 🐲 / Divine Scales 👑) | 7 skills, ult: Apocalypse Wing 🌋🌊🐉🔥`.
  - No-class error (sent before this screen): `` `❌ No class assigned! Register first with \`${getPrefix()} register\`` `` (skillCommands.js:25).
  - Text reaches user via direct `sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: msg })` — no banner.png, no result.message relay.

                              msg += `  ${rt?.icon || '💎'} ${rt?.name || r.type} (${tt?.name || r.tier}) — \`${r.runeId}\`\n`;
                          msg += `_Use \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} rune remove <runeId>\` to remove (needs scroll) or \`${botConfig.getPrefix()} rune destroy <runeId>\` to destroy._`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
💎 *Rune Slots for Shield Bash*

Capacity: 2/2 slots used

*Socketed runes:*
⚡ Power Rune (Normal) — `R-0042`
❄️ Frost Conversion Rune (Greater) — `R-0107`
```
- **Notes:** `skill.name` here comes from skillTree.js SKILL_TREES (skill looked up by scanning all 45 class trees, engine.js:17669-17682 — first match wins across classes, so shared skill ids like `cleave`/`execute` show whichever class declares them first). Slot count by tier: T1=1/T2=2/T3=3/T4-ultimate=3 (runeSystem.js:429-433). The sockets view groups by raw skillId (not display name). Empty state: `💎 *Socketed Runes*\n\n_No runes socketed. Use \`.g rune socket <runeName> <skillId>\` to socket one._` — note this one string is built with `' + prefix + '` concatenation instead of a template literal (engine.js:17712) — mixed interpolation styles.

## Section 90 — closing cross-cutting findings

1. **Data/logic vs render split:** all six files are data+logic; the praised skill-tree ASCII layout actually lives in `core/commands/skillCommands.js:16-114` (not in skillTree.js). Any UI audit of *layout* must treat skillCommands/classCommands/engine.js as the render layer.
2. **Banner drift:** the domain uses 4 different header mechanisms — `╔═╗` double-line boxes (skill tree, abilities, class guide), `┏━┓` thin boxes (SPECIALIZATION/PATH/EVOLUTION banners), plain emoji-bold titles (💎/🏆/⚡ screens), and the engine-wide GET_BANNER (never used here). Box widths vary: 15/17/23/25/27 `═`/`━` runs; the SPECIALIZATION banner's `━━━✨`...`━━━┓` runs are asymmetric (3 vs 4).
3. **Schema drift inside SKILL_TREES:** 35 legacy skills (`desc/cost/requires/effect-fn`) vs 237 structured (`description/energyCost[]/skillPointCost[]/prerequisite`); `prerequisite` (40 skills) is never enforced by canLearnSkill → skill-up gate ignores structured prerequisites; `trees[].color` (12 branches) never rendered.
4. **Dead display paths:** COMBO_ABILITIES/CLASS_SYNERGIES/ABILITY_MECHANICS descriptions+animations (skillTree.js 5594-5710), runeSynergies `✨ SYNERGY:` messages, runeSystem `modifiedEffect.synergies` strings — all written, none ever sent.
5. **desc length policy inconsistent:** Class Guide truncates class desc to first sentence (+ stray appended period), Evolution menu shows full desc, enemy `desc` fields (~60) are never shown at all.
6. **Mixed interpolation:** runeSystem/engine messages mix template literals with `' + prefix + '` concatenation; engine.js:17578 usage strings contain `\`\`` nested backticks; skillCommands consistently uses `${getPrefix()}`.
## Section 95 — rpg: summon domain (14 files)

**Coverage:** 14/14 assigned files read completely (6,163 lines) — summonSystem.js, summonRosterRenderer.js, summonCodexRenderer.js, summonSprites.js, summonEggSystem.js, summonEvolution.js, summonForging.js, summonCapture.js, summonSkillTrees.js, summonTrials.js, summonRegistry.js, summonBondTraits.js, summonAchievements.js, summonAI.js. No *.bak-* summon files exist; none skipped.
**Relay model:** 12 of 14 files return `{success, message}` objects or strings consumed by `core/commands/summonCommands.js` (`.summon*` handler, e.g. L548/575/696/733/767/987/1035/1103/1207/1666/1674/1789/2153) and `core/commands/rpgCommands.js` (hatch, L1002), which send them via `sock.sendMessage(chatId, {text: result.message})`. summonAI.js sends **directly** via its own `sock.sendMessage`. Canvas renderers return PNG buffers that summonCommands sends as image/video with captions.
**Findings headline:** 71 entries. NO entry uses GET_BANNER — headers are plain bold/emoji lines. Two entire modules are dead UI (summonCodexRenderer imported-but-never-called; summonAchievements never displayed). summonTrials data is 100% stale (references species removed from registry). Pyraxis sprite gap confirmed in summonSprites.js. Roster has 3 relay tiers (MP4 → PNG → text) cataloged under summonRosterRenderer entries.

### UI-SM-27 — Sprite pipeline + emoji fallback tiers (data, no direct text)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/summonSprites.js:29-200` (pipeline), `102-150` (DIGIMON_API_NAME_OVERRIDES, ~40 rows), `385-411` (KNOWN_MISSING, 22 ids), `422-427` (LEGACY skip-set, 14 ids)
- **Trigger:** every roster/detail/codex render (getOrFetchSprite) + boot warm-up (warmupCache, 30s delayed)
- **Type:** other (sprite resolution feeding image UI)
- **Banner:** n/a
- **Template (sample data rows):**
```
DIGIMON_API_NAME_OVERRIDES:  gallantmon: 'Dukemon',  wargreymon: 'War_Greymon',  magnaamon: 'Magnamon'
KNOWN_MISSING:  'stoneguard', 'emberdrake', 'mistwisp', 'bloompixie', … 'boglurk', 'starnail', 'tidalmaw'
LEGACY (never fetched):  'skeleton', 'imp', 'wolf', 'turret_mk1', 'wyrmling', …
```
- **Example render:** species id `wargreymon` → local cache miss → API fetch `War_Greymon.png` → white background stripped via Jimp → cached PNG → drawn on card. Species `starnail` → KNOWN_MISSING → skip fetch → renderer draws `💎` emoji.
- **Notes:** Confirms the known bug **"Pyraxis summon has no sprite"**: species id is `dragon` (name "Pyraxis", registry L41-47) — there is NO `dragon.png` in rpgasset/summons/ or retromon/, `dragon` is absent from DIGIMON_API_NAME_OVERRIDES **and** absent from KNOWN_MISSING, so `getOrFetchSprite('dragon')` tries `digi-api.com/images/digimon/w/dragon.png` (+variants) which 404s every call — repeated failed fetch per render/boot plus an `[SummonSprites] Failed to fetch` console line, then emoji fallback 🐉 in detail/codex, and a BLANK portrait in the live roster grid (UI-SM-16 has no emoji fallback). Same gap applies to the other current-registry species with no override entry (bat, boar, chest, dino, ghost, giant, mimic, mushroom, octopus, reptile, slime, snake, yeti, ship_*): the overrides map is populated for Digimon-era species that no longer exist in the registry, while the 26 live species (except the 12 KNOWN_MISSING/legacy) are mostly unresolvable. Sparklinlabs `*_idle.gif` sprites render only via the Go service (GIF tier); node-canvas cannot decode GIF, so JS tiers fall back.

### UI-SM-35 — evolveSummon success — SUMMON EVOLUTION!
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/summonEvolution.js:146-168`
- **Trigger:** `.summon evolve <id>` (all requirements met)
- **Type:** notification
- **Banner:** none — ALL-CAPS bold opener `✨ *SUMMON EVOLUTION!*`
- **Template:**
```
let msg = `✨ *SUMMON EVOLUTION!*\n\n`;
msg += `${oldSpecies?.icon || '🐉'} ${oldName} → ${nextSpeciesData.icon} *${nextSpeciesData.name}*\n\n`;
msg += `📊 *New Stats:*\n`;
msg += `❤️ HP: ${Math.floor(nextSpeciesData.baseStats.hp)}\n`;
msg += `⚔️ ATK: ${Math.floor(nextSpeciesData.baseStats.atk)}\n`;
msg += `🛡️ DEF: ${Math.floor(nextSpeciesData.baseStats.def)}\n`;
msg += `🔮 MAG: ${Math.floor(nextSpeciesData.baseStats.mag)}\n`;
msg += `💨 SPD: ${nextSpeciesData.baseStats.spd}\n\n`;
msg += `🏷️ Tier: ${reqs.tier} | Rarity: ${nextSpeciesData.rarity}\n`;
msg += `💖 Loyalty: Reset to 100\n\n`;
msg += `_${nextSpeciesData.desc}_\n\n`;
msg += `_Cost: 1x ${reqs.essenceName} + ${ZENI}${reqs.zeniCost.toLocaleString()}_`;
(final-stage only) msg += `\n\n🎉 *FINAL EVOLUTION REACHED!* This summon has achieved its ultimate form!`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
✨ *SUMMON EVOLUTION!*

🐉 Pyraxis → 🔥 *Emberwick*

📊 *New Stats:*
❤️ HP: 240
⚔️ ATK: 12
🛡️ DEF: 26
🔮 MAG: 10
💨 SPD: 5

🏷️ Tier: ASCENDED | Rarity: UNCOMMON
💖 Loyalty: Reset to 100

_A squat wax creature with a living flame atop its head. Nearly immovable once planted._

_Cost: 1x Summon Essence (T2) + ⌀10,000_
```
- **Notes:** Stats shown are the NEW SPECIES base stats, not the summon's actual evolved stats (level growth applied later via applyLevelGrowth) — displayed numbers can mismatch the roster. SPD lacks `Math.floor` (inconsistent with the other four lines). Header comment says "a global announcement is sent if it's a final evolution stage" (L22) but only the local message gets the `🎉 *FINAL EVOLUTION REACHED!*` suffix — no global broadcast exists. Relayed via summonCommands cmdEvolve L1789→`sock.sendMessage(text: result.message)`.

'❌ Cannot forge a summon with itself.'
'❌ One or both summons not found in your collection.'
`❌ Insufficient Zeni. Soul Forging costs ${goldCost.toLocaleString()} Zeni (you have ${user.wallet.toLocaleString()}).`
'❌ Failed to deduct Zeni. Please try again.'
'❌ Forging failed: invalid species combination.'
'❌ Forging failed: could not consume parent summons.'
'❌ CRITICAL ERROR: Parents were consumed but the fused summon failed to save. Contact an admin.'
```
- **Example render:**
```
❌ Insufficient Zeni. Soul Forging costs 118,000 Zeni (you have 40,250).
```
- **Notes:** Nine literals, two distinct ⚔️-prefixed "Forging failed:" siblings. The CRITICAL ERROR message is user-facing output for a data-loss path (parents deleted, save failed) — an ops message leaking into chat. Cost = 50,000 + 1,000 × combined levels (FORGE_CONFIG L34-35).

### UI-SM-56 — getBondDisplay (bond progress screen fragment)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/summonBondTraits.js:76-94`
- **Trigger:** `.summon bond <id>` (embedded under caller header `💖 *BOND — <name>*`)
- **Type:** progress
- **Banner:** none (caller supplies bold header)
- **Template:**
```
let msg = `💖 Bond: ${bond}/100 (${label})\n`;
if (tier?.statMult) msg += `   ✨ +${Math.round(tier.statMult * 100)}% all stats\n`;
if (tier?.loyaltyDecayReduction > 0) msg += `   🛡️ Loyalty decays ${Math.round(tier.loyaltyDecayReduction * 100)}% slower\n`;
if (tier?.echoBoost > 0) msg += `   💀 Echo buff +${Math.round(tier.echoBoost * 100)}% stronger\n`;
if (tier?.comboAttack) msg += `   ⚔️ Combo attack unlocked!\n`;
if (tier?.noLoyaltyDecay) msg += `   ♾️ Loyalty never decays\n`;
if (nextThreshold) msg += `   _Next: ${nextLabel} at bond ${nextThreshold} (${xpToNext} combats left)_`;
```
- **Example render:**
```
💖 Bond: 32/100 (Trusted)
   ✨ +10% all stats
   🛡️ Loyalty decays 25% slower
   💀 Echo buff +25% stronger
   _Next: Bonded at bond 50 (8 combats left)_
```
- **Notes:** Caller bug (summonCommands cmdBond L1941): `resolveSummon(summons, summonNum)` references an undefined variable `summonNum` → `.summon bond <id>` throws ReferenceError before display — **this fragment is currently unreachable** (same latent bug in cmdTraits L1972 and cmdAIMode L2081). Tier labels (Acquainted/Trusted/Bonded/Soulbound/Eternal) from BOND_THRESHOLDS L28-34. `xpToNext` math uses `10 - bondXp` but bond increments 1 per 10 XP — "combats left" assumes exactly 1 bond XP per combat while actual grant is random 1-3 (summonAI L512) → estimate systematically wrong.

Same literal duplicated 4× for the enemy_damage / enemy_debuff / shield / standard buff branches — identical output for all echo types despite different mechanics. Shrapnel/dragonfear branches return before applying any visible difference — user text can't distinguish "dealt 50 damage to all enemies" from a plain buff (desc does the work). Echo icon+desc come straight from the ECHOES table (UI-SM-53).

---

## Cross-cutting observations

1. **No GET_BANNER usage** — all 71 elements use bare bold/emoji openers or plain lines; the ┏━┓ box style from engine.js never appears in the summon domain.
2. **ALL-CAPS bold openers** (`*EGG HATCHED!*`, `*SUMMON EVOLUTION!*`, `*SOUL FORGED!*`, `*SOUL CAPTURED!*`, `*TRIAL FAILED*`, `*TRIAL COMPLETE!*`, `*SKILL UNLOCKED!*`) — a consistent house style for celebratory blocks, but success glyphs vary (🥚/✨/⚔️/💀/⚔️/✨).
3. **Dead UI inventory:** summonCodexRenderer (24-26, imported never called), summonAchievements (59, display API never called), summonTrials data (47/50 unreachable — stale species), personality-override msgs (61-63), personality shift (68), plus `*(empty)*`/`role`/`filter` dead interpolations.
4. **WhatsApp-markdown defects:** `**double asterisks**` in summonAI (68, 71); roster PNG codex footer/hub hints hardcode `.summon` without prefix interpolation (18, 19, 26, 43, 46).
5. **Duplicated literals across flows:** `'❌ Summon not found in your collection.'` (deploy/train/release), `'❌ User not found.'` (deploy/train/forge/trial), for-sale wording in 3 phrasings (deploy/train/trial/forge).
# Section 100 — rpg: combat/abyss domain (11 files)

## Section 100 — rpg: combat/abyss domain (11 files)
Coverage: 11/11 assigned files read in full (13,948 LOC; `*.bak-*` skipped). 76 UI entries catalogued.
Files: abyssSystem.js, bossMechanics.js, combatImageGenerator.js, combatIntegration.js, craftingSystem.js, durabilitySystem.js, inventorySystem.js, lootSystem.js, monsterSkills.js, performEnemyAction_new.js, threatSystem.js.
Text relay: almost all module strings return via `result.message` and are sent by `core/engine.js` (`.g abyss …`, L17922-18296) or `core/commands/rpgCommands.js` (`.bag/.craft/.use/.enhance/.sell/.dismantle/.mine`) as `sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: BOT_MARKER + msg })`; crafting success strings are instead sent as the **caption of a Go-service transaction-card image** (`image: imgBuf, caption: result.message`, rpgCommands.js:805). performEnemyAction_new.js sends directly via `sock.sendMessage` but is orphaned (see UI-CB-44).

---

# A. abyssSystem.js (core/rpg/abyssSystem.js, 1015 lines)

### UI-CB-01 — Abyss "run already active" blocker

- **Trigger:** `.g abyss enter` (via engine.js startRun) while an active run exists (< 30 min old)
- **Type:** error

- **Template:**
```
❌ You already have an active Abyss run on floor ${existing.currentFloor}.
_Continue with `${P()} abyss status` or retreat with `${P()} abyss retreat`._

_Continue with `.g abyss status` or retreat with `.g abyss retreat`._

### UI-CB-15 — **Abyss enemy display name + emoji (KNOWN BUG #2)** — enemy types defined but no per-type stats/skills/icon/sprite
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/abyssSystem.js:73-99 (pools), 409-455 (generateFloorEnemy)`
- **Trigger:** every abyss combat floor generation
- **Type:** other (enemy identity data feeding all headers above)
- **Banner:** n/a
- **Template:**
```
name = enemyId.replace(/_/g, ' ');          // e.g. 'CAVE BAT'
name: isBoss ? `⚡ ${name}` : name,          // boss gets ⚡ prefix ONLY
baseStats = { hp: Math.floor(500 * mult), maxHp: …, atk: Math.floor(40*mult), def: Math.floor(15*mult), spd: Math.floor(15*mult) }   // boss: 2000/80/30/20 × mult
return { id: `abyss_${tier}_${floor}_${Date.now()}`, name, hp, maxHp, atk, def, spd, isBoss, level: Math.max(1, floor) }
```
- **Example render:** `⚔️ *Floor 1 — CAVE BAT*` / `🕳️ *Floor 25* — ⚡ ELDER CHAOS` / combat engine fallback icon `👾` (regular) or `👹` (boss) — see Notes.
- **Notes:** **Enemy-type-specific stats/skills are MISSING by construction**: 30+ enemy IDs (ABYSS_ENEMY_POOLS L73-83: `RABID_RAT, CAVE_BAT, EMBER_SPAWN, FROST_WISP, SLIME … ABYSSAL_GOD`) are defined ONLY as strings; stats are tier-generic formulas (identical for a rat and a Void Titan on the same floor). No `icon` field → guildAdventure.startAbyssCombat (L5976) falls back `enemy.icon || (enemy.isBoss ? '👹' : '👾')` — **every regular abyss enemy shows 👾, every boss shows 👹** in combat lines. No `archetype` → all regular enemies use monsterSkills `BRUTE` "Ravager" kit, all bosses the generic `BOSS` kit; bossMechanics.js BOSS_REGISTRY data is never applied to abyss bosses. No `spriteIndex` → see UI-CB-17. Enemy ID embeds `Date.now()`, making image `bossId` keys unique garbage (UI-CB-17).

# B. combatImageGenerator.js (core/rpg/combatImageGenerator.js, 206 lines)

### UI-CB-17 — **Combat image enemy payload — sprite selection (KNOWN BUG #1: "all abyss enemies render same sprite")**
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/combatImageGenerator.js:37-46`
- **Trigger:** every combat scene render (START/TURN/END phases, abyss + dungeons)
- **Type:** other (image composition input — determines the sprite the user sees)
- **Banner:** n/a
- **Template:**
```
enemies: enemies.map(e => ({
    name: String(e.name || 'Enemy'),
    currentHP: …, maxHp: …,
    isBoss: Boolean(e.isBoss),
    justDied: Boolean(e.justDied),
    spriteIndex: Math.floor(Number(e.spriteIndex) || 0),
    bossId: String(e.id || e.name || '').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_'),
    level: Math.floor(Number(e.level || e.stats?.level || 1))
})),
```
- **Example render:** abyss enemy `{name:'CAVE BAT', spriteIndex:0, bossId:'ABYSS_F_1_169…'}` → Go service renders enemy sprite slot 0 for every abyss mob.
- **Notes:** **Selection logic:** the Go microservice picks an enemy sprite from `core/rpgasset/enemies/` (Bat_0000_dark.png, Werewolf_0004_brown.png, boss_N_N/boss_N_S series …) via (a) `bossId` — an uppercase underscore key matched against a boss sprite map — or (b) `spriteIndex` (0-based index into the enemy sprite sheet). **Abyss enemies never set `spriteIndex`** (generateFloorEnemy, UI-CB-15) so `Number(undefined)||0` → **always 0 → same sprite for every abyss enemy**. Their `bossId` is derived from `abyss_${tier}_${floor}_${Date.now()}` (a unique timestamp garbage key, never in any sprite map) or from the display name `'⚡ INFECTED COLOSSUS'` → `'⚡_INFECTED_COLOSSUS'` (emoji + wrong casing, no map hit). By contrast dungeon bosses use registry IDs like `HIVE_COMMANDER` (bossMechanics.js) which do hit the map. No per-abyss-enemy sprite-map exists anywhere in the repo — fix requires mapping enemy IDs → spriteIndex/bossId at enemy construction.

### UI-CB-20 — Static combat PNG (generateCombatImage + action payload)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/combatImageGenerator.js:71-116`
- **Trigger:** every START/TURN render; END phase does not use this
- **Type:** other (image render call site)
- **Banner:** n/a

```
payload.action = buildActionPayload(options.action);
// { attackerSide:'player'|'enemy'|'summon', attackerIndex, targetSide, targetIndex,
//   skillName, element:'physical|fire|ice|lightning|dark|holy|none', vfx:'',
//   damage, isCrit, missed, heal }
const imageBuffer = options.bypassQueue
    ? await goService.generateCombatImageDirect(payload)   // PvP duels

Sent to the chat alongside the text caption (UI-CB-25/26) by guildAdventure.js. Error path returns `{success:false}` and the caption still goes out as text.

### UI-CB-31 — generateCombatScene dispatcher (image + caption composition)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/combatIntegration.js:329-389`
- **Trigger:** every combat scene request from guildAdventure.js
- **Type:** other (pipeline)
- **Banner:** n/a

```

case 'TURN':  image = renderCombatTurn(...);  caption = generateTurnCaption(...)
case 'END':   image = renderCombatEnd(...);   caption = generateEndCaption(...)

```
- **Example render:** image message + caption message per phase.
- **Notes:** **Division of labor:** everything numeric (sprites, HP bars, rank, floor, damage numbers, turn indicator, VFX) is drawn INTO the PNG by the Go service (rpgasset backgrounds/characters/enemies/summons/fonts/icons/ui/vfx); the caption text (UI-CB-25..27) is sent as a separate WhatsApp message. TURN phase filters combatants to `currentHP > 0 || justDied`. buildAnimationAction (L65-158) returns null for rest/flee/defend/charging turns and regex-maps skill names to elements (fire/ice/lightning/dark/holy).

### UI-CB-32 — Boss phase-transition announcements
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/bossMechanics.js:66-72 (BossPhaseManager.transitionToPhase)`; per-boss strings L129, 164, 205, 288, 331, 378, 455, 508, 557, 636, 674, 710, 757, 767, 834, 858, 886, 913, 952, 984
- **Trigger:** boss HP crosses a phase threshold (checkPhaseTransition on each processed turn)
- **Type:** notification (boss announcement)
- **Banner:** quoted roleplay line; default fallback `Boss enters Phase ${phaseIndex + 1}!`
- **Template:**
```
message: phase.message || `Boss enters Phase ${phaseIndex + 1}!`
```
- **Example render:**
```
🦟👑 "THE HIVE WILL NOT DIE WITH ME!"
```
- **Samples (6 bosses × 2-6 phases):**
  - Hive Commander (🦟👑): `🦟👑 "The Hive commands — you will be consumed!"` → `🦟👑 "You wounded the Hive?! The swarm RAGES!"` → `🦟👑 "THE HIVE WILL NOT DIE WITH ME!"`
  - Plague Priest (☣️🧙): `☣️ "Foolish mortals. The Infection claims all."` → `☣️ "Your bodies will fuel the Plague's spread!"` → `☣️ "BEHOLD THE TRUE FACE OF THE PLAGUE!"`
  - Corrupted Overlord (🦠👑): `🦠👑 "You dare oppose the Corruption?!"` → `🦠👑 "NOW WITNESS TRUE CORRUPTION!"` → `🦠👑 "WITNESS THE CORRUPTION OF ALL THINGS!"`
  - Void-Corrupted (🌑👁️): `🌑 *Corrupted whispers flood your mind with infection...*` → `🌑 *The infection tears reality apart*` → `🌑 *CORRUPTED OBLIVION AWAITS*`
  - Ancient Dragon (🐲🔥): `🐲 "You dare enter my nesting ground?!"` → `🔥 THE AIR GROWS SCORCHING HOT!` (2 phases only, thresholds 100/50)
  - Primordial Chaos (🌟🌑): 6 phases — `🌟 "In the beginning, there was Chaos."` → `⚖️ "All things exist in balance."` → `🌊🔥 "Feel the raw power of the elements!"` → `🌑 "Return to nothingness!"` → `💥 "WITNESS THE END AND BEGINNING AS ONE!"` → `🌟🌑 "I AM THE ALPHA AND OMEGA!"`
- **Notes:** Void-Corrupted lines use `*…*` bold+italic mix; others are plain quoted strings — formatting drift between bosses. Return shape `{ phase, message, abilities, mechanics }` — message relayed by whichever engine consumes transitions (classEncounters.js/adminConsole.js consume BOSS_REGISTRY; the full phase engine is not wired into guildAdventure's live combat).

```
- **Samples:** `🌑 *MYTHIC DROP!* The Void Titan's Heart still pulses with dimensional energy!` · `🌌 *MYTHIC DROP!* A Godshard — fragment of the Abyssal God's divine essence — descends!` · `👑 *MYTHIC DROP!* The Infernal Crown materializes in flames!` · `🔥 *LEGENDARY DROP!* The Dragon's Heart still beats with ancient power!` · `💎 *LEGENDARY DROP!* A Titan Heart emerges from the golem's core!` · `🌟 *LEGENDARY DROP!* A Mirror Essence materializes from the Lich's remains!` · `🩸 *LEGENDARY DROP!* Elder Blood pools with ancient magic!` · `🌌 *MYTHIC DROP!* The Void Essence fractures reality itself!` — plus egg drops WITHOUT the banner: `🌑 An egg of pure darkness condenses from the void!` · `🥚 A common summon egg materializes!` · `💀 A necrotic egg drops from the Lich's remains!` · `🦴 A bone-white egg clatters to the ground!` · `🐉 A scaled, warm egg drops from the Dragon!`

Boss keys are UPPERCASE here (matches ABYSS_BOSS_POOL ids like ELDER_CHAOS — note VOID_CORRUPTED here vs `void_corrupted` in bossMechanics registry, casing mismatch across files).

### UI-CB-65 — Random equipment name affixes (prefix/suffix generation)

prefixes = [ Sturdy{def:5,hp:15}, Sharp{atk:8}, Glowing{mag:10}, Light{spd:10}, Lucky{luck:15} ]
suffixes = [ 'of Might'{atk:15}, 'of Protection'{def:10}, 'of Haste'{spd:15}, 'of Sages'{mag:20}, 'of Fortune'{luck:25} ]

### UI-CB-68 — ITEM_DATABASE (display names + descriptions)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/lootSystem.js:778-1150 (main), 1166-3554 (extrapolated block, ~180 more items)`
- **Trigger:** item inspect, shop, bag, craft-recipe lists, FINDING screen
- **Type:** other (big data table — described, not dumped)
- **Banner:** n/a
- **Template:**
```
'refined_steel': { name: 'Refined Steel', description: 'High-quality steel. Tastes like pennies.', rarity: 'UNCOMMON', value: 500, type: 'MATERIAL' },
```
- **Samples:** `'dark_matter': 'Dark Matter' — 'Heavier than your student loans.' (EPIC 2500)` · `'mana_dew': 'Mana Dew' — 'Basically magic Gatorade.' (RARE 800)` · `'gold_pile': 'Pile of Gold' — 'Glinting Zeni coins.' (COMMON, value 1)` · equipment entries embed stat text in description: `'steel_sabre': 'Steel Sabre' — 'Sharp and finely forged. (+25 ATK, +5 SPD)'`
- **Notes:** ~330 items total. Descriptions double as stat tooltips (+N ATK) — the only place stat summaries exist for display. **Duplicate key bug:** `abyssal_core` defined TWICE — L1072 (SUMMON_GEAR 'Abyssal Core' EPIC 80,000, summonSlot core) and L1116 (MATERIAL 'Abyssal Core' MYTHIC 650,000) — the later literal silently overwrites the summon-gear entry, so summon-gear drops render as MYTHIC material. Extrapolated block (L1166+) uses JSON-style quoted keys and legacy `slot: "weapon"` (vs `main_hand` in the hand-written entries) — inconsistent slot vocabulary. Affected item names include 'Void Kraken Harpoon', 'Hellfire Greatmaul', 'Tattered Rag Shawl'.

(lv30/B/ml15, 40⚡)` · `'void_fissure': 'Void Fissure' — 'A tear in reality where dark matter and mana crystals crystallize.' (lv50/S/ml30, 60⚡)`
- **Notes:** 4 locations. Ore entries inconsistently use `min/max` vs `quantity` fields (volcanic_hollow fire_shard uses `quantity: 1`, void_fissure legendary_shard too) — schema drift.

# K. threatSystem.js (core/rpg/threatSystem.js, 177 lines) — NO UI ELEMENTS

**Coverage note:** threatSystem.js is pure combat logic (class threat multipliers TANK 1.5×/DPS 1.0×/MAGIC 0.8×/SUPPORT 0.6×, summon 0.7×; 50/30/20 highest-threat/lowest-HP/random target selection; taunt force-target). It contains ZERO user-facing strings — no threat/aggro notices are ever rendered anywhere in this file; aggro changes are invisible to the user (enemy-targeting lines like UI-CB-47 mention only the chosen target, never the reason). Taunt application messages, if any, live in the class-skill engine (outside assigned files). This resolves the task item "threat/aggro notices": **none exist in this file by design.**

## Section 105 — rpg: guild/raid/pvp domain (7 files)

Coverage: guilds.js (1559 ln), guildAdventure.js (10402 ln), guildWars.js (696 ln), guildPerks.js (482 ln), pvpSystem.js (1904 ln), raidSystem.js (818 ln), broadcastHelpers.js (67 ln) — all read in full, branch audit/fix-pass-1.
Delivery paths: (a) pure renderers return `{message}` → engine.js sends as `BOT_MARKER + result.message` (e.g. engine.js:8726, 18414, 18814); (b) guildAdventure.js/pvpSystem.js send ~59 messages DIRECTLY via `sock.sendMessage` (marked per entry); (c) raid/war spawn messages are logged to console only by index.js schedulers (dead path — see UI-GL-41 notes).

### UI-GL-22 — guild system guide
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/guilds.js:1405-1489`
- **Trigger:** `.g guild guide`
- **Type:** menu
- **Banner:** ┏━━━ box `┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓\n┃  🏰 GUILD SYSTEM GUIDE  ┃\n┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛` (23-wide, unlike the 15-wide boxes elsewhere)
- **Template:**
```
┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓
┃  🏰 GUILD SYSTEM GUIDE  ┃
┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

*GETTING STARTED*
• `${prefix} guild create <name>` — Create a new guild
• `${prefix} guild join <name>` — Join an existing guild
• `${prefix} guild leave` — Leave your current guild
• `${prefix} guild list` — See all guilds

*GUILD ARCHETYPES*
Choose an archetype when creating (default: ADVENTURER):
• ⚔️ ADVENTURER — +15% XP from dungeons
• 💰 MERCHANT — +10% gold + 10% sell value
• 🧪 RESEARCH — -10% crafting material cost

*GUILD LEVELS & XP*
Guilds level up by earning XP from member activities:
• Dungeon clears: +5 to +100 XP (by rank)
• Boss kills: +10 XP
• PvP wins: +5 XP
• Item sales: +5% of value as XP
• Donations: +1 XP per 100K Zeni (max 100 XP per donation)

Guild level perks:
• L2: +5% XP for all members
• L3: +5% gold for all members
• L5: Guild bank earns daily interest
• L7: +1 skill point on adventurer rank-up
• L10: Access to guild-only dungeon rank

*GUILD BUILDINGS*
Upgrade buildings with guild points (`${prefix} guild upgrade <id>`):
• Hall: +5 member cap per level (base 20, max 45)
• Training: +5% XP per level (max +25%)
• Treasury: +10% gold per level (max +50%) + bank interest

*GUILD ROLES (4-tier system)*
• 👑 Leader — full control (can disband, set roles, emblem)
• ⚔️ Officer — can kick/invite/manage
• 🌿 Member — full guild access (loans, board, etc.)
• 💤 Recruit — limited (cannot borrow from bank)
Set roles: `${prefix} guild role @user <recruit|member|officer>`

*GUILD BANK & LOANS*
• `${prefix} guild donate <amount>` — Donate Zeni to guild bank
• `${prefix} guild loan <amount>` — Borrow (max 10% of bank, 7-day repayment)
• `${prefix} guild loan list` — View your active loans
• `${prefix} guild loan repay <amount>` — Repay early
Overdue loans: 10% auto-deducted daily from wallet, or 5% penalty compounds.
Bank interest (L5+): 0.5%/treasury level daily, capped at 1M/day.

*GUILD PERKS*
• `${prefix} guild perks` — View your active multipliers
• `${prefix} guild info` — Full guild status dashboard

*GUILD MANAGEMENT*
• `${prefix} guild invite @user` — Send invite (1 hour to accept)
• `${prefix} accept` — Accept a pending invite
• `${prefix} decline` — Decline a pending invite
• `${prefix} guild promote @user` — Promote to officer
• `${prefix} guild demote @user` — Demote officer
• `${prefix} guild kick @user` — Remove member
• `${prefix} guild title @user <title>` — Set custom title
• `${prefix} guild motto <text>` — Set guild motto
• `${prefix} guild emblem <emoji> [hexColor]` — Set guild emblem
• `${prefix} guild delete` — Disband guild (Leader only)

*GUILD WAR (weekly)*
• `${prefix} war` — View this week's event
• Earn points from dungeons, bosses, PvP, raids, Abyss
• 4 rotating events: Tournament, Clash, Hunt, Siege
• Rewards: 1st=5M Zeni + buff, 2nd-3rd=2M, 4th-8th=500K

*OTHER COMMANDS*
• `${prefix} guild members` — View roster
• `${prefix} guild ranks` — Members by adventurer rank
• `${prefix} guild titles` — Roster with titles
• `${prefix} guild board` — Daily monster hunting board
• `${prefix} guild tag <msg>` — Mention all guild members
• `${prefix} guild leaderboard` — Top guilds by level/XP
• `${prefix} guild points` — Your guild's XP
• `${prefix} guild upgrade` — Upgrade buildings menu
```
- **Example render:** (as shown — filled with `.g` prefix)
- **Notes:** engine.js:17250 relays `getGuildGuide(prefix)` as plain text. Inconsistencies: guide says "Upgrade buildings with guild points" but code deducts guild BALANCE (guilds.js:1297); guide's loan list omits overdue rate "5% penalty compounds" ok; archetype XP says "dungeons" while GUILD_ARCHETYPES text says "monsters" (guilds.js:27). `\n` escapes inside template literal — renders as newlines correctly.

(Target was already alive)
(Item effect activated)
```

⚔️ Kai: 🎒 Uses *Elixir*!
💖 Restored 12400 HP to Kai! (100%)
✨ Cured 2 negative status effect(s)!
```

## Cross-file style inconsistencies (top findings)

1. **Five box widths** for the `┏━━┓` banner: 12 (DUNGEONS/PRE-RAID/CROSSROAD/EVOLVED), 15 (ANNOUNCE/UPGRADED/CHALLENGE), 16 (TRIAL FAILED), 23 (GUILD GUIDE), 30/34 (Leviathan boxes) — none use the engine's canonical GET_BANNER.
2. **Five divider styles**: `———————————` (pvp, 11 em-dashes), `━━━ 12/14/15/19` (guildAdventure menus), `─────────` (roundLog flush, 9 hyphens), `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━` (guild board).
3. **Two HP-bar glyph sets**: `█░` (guild board) vs `▰▱` (combat prompt); raid shows no bar at all (plain numbers).
4. **PvE vs PvP command vocabularies diverge**: PvE prompt says `combat atk/skill/item/def`, PvP says `combat attack/ability/item`; the Abyss floor card advertises `combat attack` inside the PvE engine.
5. **Dead paths**: raid spawn/victory/war spawn messages are never sent by schedulers (console.log only); CHALLENGE_TYPES is empty so the challenge box can never render; `rest` action unreachable; ${modeEmoji} unused; rune `${runeDrop}` always empty.
6. **Factually wrong display text**: PvP flee footer says "50% Wallet" (actual 10% cap 5K); joinRaid shows class in the "Lv" slot; raid top-3 all print `🥇🥈🥉`; gold-capped reward row drops GP/Survived lines; STRONGHOLD SIEGE header has `,` for `—`.
7. **Duplicated render logic**: PvP combat-bag menu ≈ PvE combat items menu; PvP status lines vs PvE status ticks use different bold conventions (`*X*` vs `**X**`); enemy ability text reuses player grammar; guild full/emoji member-count drift (`👥` vs `💥`).
## Section 110 — rpg: economy/social/players (10 files)

## Coverage summary

- **Files audited (10/10, read completely, read-only):** `core/rpg/economy.js` (2560 L), `investment.js` (137), `loans.js` (388), `stockMarket.js` (123), `socialSystem.js` (102), `bountySystem.js` (348), `profileCardRenderer.js` (542), `progression.js` (563), `altDetection.js` (143), `testerSystem.js` (281). No *.bak-* files touched.
- **Delivery mechanism (all files):** these are pure logic/renderer modules — they return `{success, message|msg}` and **engine.js relays the string verbatim** as `sock.sendMessage(chatId, { text: BOT_MARKER + result.message })` (e.g. register @ engine L23224, daily @ L23478, loan @ L23301, invest @ L22680/22693, stocks @ L22628, bounty @ L17793, membership @ L22818). `profileCardRenderer` returns a PNG buffer rendered by node-canvas, sent as `image:` + caption by `core/commands/rpgCommands.js` L108-112.
- **⚠️ Critical finding re: bug-list item 1 (literal `\n` artifacts):** exhaustive grep of all 10 files found **ZERO literal backslash-n artifacts**. Every `\n` in these files sits inside backtick template literals (or engine relays them raw), i.e. they are REAL newlines when rendered (full occurrence list: economy.js L53, 224, 973, 1005, 1013, 1022, 1026, 1091, 1098, 1102, 1117, 1127, 1167, 1172, 1176, 1188, 1197, 1267, 1318, 1429, 1470, 1697, 1699, 1712-1717, 1950, 1955, 1961, 1990, 2000, 2003, 2008, 2016, 2330; investment.js L72, 113, 121, 125; loans.js L123, 163, 239, 262; bountySystem.js L97, 176, 225, 232; socialSystem.js L96; testerSystem.js L188-189, 213). The visible-`\n` bug in the issue-report/pardon family must therefore live in the **caller layer** (engine.js hand-built concatenations, e.g. L12220-12326, and commands/*.js) — flag for cross-check with Sections 10-60 (engine) and 115 (misc). Quirk found instead: **loans.js mixes `\n` escapes and real newlines inside the SAME template literal** (L163-171, L239-243) — renders correctly but is a maintenance hazard.

**Shared style notes (economy.js):** no GET_BANNER box usage anywhere in these files — headers are `EMOJI *ALL-CAPS TITLE*` style; body sections framed by plain `━` divider lines. **Divider drift measured:** 15 `━` chars everywhere (register L343/352, daily, deposit, withdraw) **except transferMoney L1071/1076 which uses 16 `━`** — the two screens will not line up. The `┏━┓ BALANCE/HISTORY/PROFILE` boxes flagged in the context are **NOT in economy.js** — they are hand-copied in engine.js (L23327-23338 etc.); economy.js only supplies data (`getBankBalance`, `getUser`). Duplicate logic: the exact `❌ *NOT REGISTERED*` template is copy-pasted 3× (deposit L1091, withdraw L1167, claimDaily L1267) but NOT in buyMembership (L1407 uses a one-liner instead — inconsistent).

### UI-EC-43 — Loan request sent (mixed \n + literal newlines)
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/loans.js:161-172`

Amount: ${getZENI()}${amount}

Waiting for them to type:
✅ `.j accept`
❌ `.j decline`
```
- **Notes:** ⚠️ **style hazard flagged for the \n bug family:** this template MIXES `\n\n` escapes (first line) with real newlines (rest) inside one template literal — renders correctly today, but it is exactly the pattern that produces literal-`\n` drift when copy-pasted into single-quoted engine code. Note the template echoes RAW user input: `Amount: ${amount}` / `Interest: ${interestRate}%` interpolate the unvalidated argument, so `.j loan @x 1e3 0x10 5` echoes back `Amount: ⋂1e3` (not the validated `amt`). Engine relays with `mentions: [lender]` (L23303). DM notification to the lender: **none** — only the group message with mention.

function getLevelDisplay(level) {
  const icons = ['🌑', '🌘', '🌗', '🌖', '🌕', '☀️', '⭐', '🌟', '✨', '👑'];

### UI-EC-64 — Progress bar helper
- **Loc:** `core/rpg/progression.js:509-512`
- **Trigger:** embedded in XP screens by callers (progressionCommands.js L105 — `.g stats` XP bar, length 15)
- **Type:** progress
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
function getProgressBar(percent, length = 10) {
  const filled = Math.floor((Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percent)) / 100) * length);
  return `[${'█'.repeat(filled)}${'░'.repeat(Math.max(0, length - filled))}]`;
}
```
- **Example render:**
```
[██████████░░░░░]
```
- **Notes:** the ONLY text progress bar in the assigned files; all other bars are canvas-drawn (UI-EC-61) or absent. Clamp 0-100.

Issue #a3f9c2 [bug/high] by Kaze on 2026-09-14T18:22:01.031Z:
PvP initiative is wrong when spd ties
```
- **Notes:** the submit/confirmation/list UI (`.j bug` → `✅ *BUG REPORTED*`, `.j issues` → `📋 *TESTER ISSUES*` loop renderer) is **engine.js-owned** (L12220-12326) — testerSystem.js only stores/fetches (submitIssue/listIssues return raw docs with NO message field). ⚠️ re the literal-`\n` bug: the `\n`s at L188-189/L213 are template-literal escapes (real newlines); the visible backslash-n artifacts reported in the bug list are NOT produced by this file — they must come from the engine/commands layer that renders the stored issue bodies (cross-check engine sections). The Groq system prompt (L192-211) is AI-facing, not user-facing (excluded). Groq model: `llama-3.3-70b-versatile` default, temp 0.3, max_tokens 4000.

## Section 110 summary

- **Entries: 68** (UI-EC-01 … UI-EC-68) across 10 files: economy.js 37, investment.js 4, loans.js 5, stockMarket.js 5, socialSystem.js 1, bountySystem.js 8, profileCardRenderer.js 2, progression.js 3, altDetection.js 1, testerSystem.js 2.
- **Type mix:** error families ≈ 25 entries, confirm/stat screens ≈ 15, notifications ≈ 12, progress/list fragments 5, image cards 2, data/dead fragments 4, misc 5.
- **Notable dead paths:** economy.sellItem (live path = inventorySystem), loans.declineLoan template (engine sends its own), socialSystem.getRelationshipsText (zero callers), wealth-tax `report` (no consumer), progression achievement stubs, bountySystem placerPhone param.
- **Notable inconsistencies:** 16-━ vs 15-━ divider drift (transfer vs everything); NOT REGISTERED duplicated 3× but bypassed by buyMembership; loans.js mixed `\n`+literal newlines; progression.js errors have no emoji; bountySystem says "Zeni" instead of ⛁; profile card is node-canvas (Go = fallback) while balance card is Go-first (node text = fallback); raw user input echoed unvalidated in loan request template; loans MIN_LOAN TDZ crash.
## Section 115 — gambling, games, reactions, utils

**Coverage:** 16 assigned files read completely (core/gambling.js 2,553 ln; core/games/{chess,debate,ludo,tictactoe,wordle}.js; reactions/{config,handler,fallbacks}.js; core/utils/{security,goImageService,powerscale,profileHelper,news,anikaiResolver,lidResolver,system}.js). 99 UI entries. Engine relay paths verified at core/engine.js L24005-24675 (`reply(result.message)`), L7510-7567 (reactions), L7244-7304 & L9130-9183 (powerscale), L5288-5314 (news).

**Delivery mechanisms (applies to all entries below):**
- **gambling.js** — every game function RETURNS `{ success, message }`; nothing is sent directly. core/engine.js calls e.g. `gambling.coinflip(...)` (L24005) then `await reply(result.message)` (L24011). `reply()` (engine L6569-6576) wraps as `{ text: BOT_MARKER + content }` sent with `{ quoted: m }`. BOT_MARKER is a zero-width space `\u200B` (engine L1252) — effectively invisible. **Quirk:** messages embed `@${economy.getDisplayName(userId)}` but `reply()` attaches no `contextInfo.mentions`, so @-handles may not highlight.
- **chess/ludo/ttt/wordle** — handlers receive `sock` and call `sock.sendMessage(...)` DIRECTLY inside the module (captions on image messages, or text with `contextInfo.mentionedJid`).
- **reactions/handler.js** — sends GIF-converted MP4 directly via `sock.sendMessage` with caption.
- **powerscale.js** — returns `{ message }`; engine relays as `BOT_MARKER + result.message` (L9171), or as image+caption when `result.imageUrl` exists (L7273-7276).
- **security.js** — sends kick/warn notices directly inside the module.

### UI-MS-01 — Shared bet-validation error cluster
- **Loc:** `core/gambling.js:147,155,160,163,167` (coinflip) + same pattern per game (see table)
- **Trigger:** any gambling command with bad bet/registration state (e.g. `.j dice`, `.j slots 100`)
- **Type:** error
- **Banner:** none (single-line)
- **Template:**
```
❌ Register first with `${botConfig.getPrefix()} register <nickname>`!
```
```
❌ Invalid bet amount!
```
```
❌ Minimum bet is ${getZENI()}${GLOBAL_MIN_BET.toLocaleString()}!
```
```
❌ Maximum bet is ${getZENI()}${GLOBAL_MAX_BET.toLocaleString()}!
```
```
❌ You only have ${getZENI()}${user.wallet.toLocaleString()}!
```
- **Example render:**
```
❌ Register first with `.j register <nickname>`!

❌ Minimum bet is 🪙50!
```
- **Notes:** Returned to engine, relayed by `reply()`. Per-game drift (identical-except-values variants):
  | Game (loc) | Register text | Funds text |
  |---|---|---|
  | coinflip/dice/slots/roulette/crash/higherLower/lottery/rps/penalty/guess (e.g. L147, L256, L378, L886, L1076, L1547, L1642, L1759, L1864) | `❌ Register first with \`${prefix} register <nickname>\`!` (template literal) | `❌ You only have ${getZENI()}${user.wallet.toLocaleString()}!` |
  | blackjack (L569) | same | `❌ You only have ${getZENI()}${user.wallet}!` (no toLocaleString) |
  | mines/plinko/scratch/cup/wheel (L1230, L2098, L2237, L2355, L2442) | `❌ Register first!` (short form, plain quotes) | `❌ Insufficient funds!` |
  | slots (L393) | same | `❌ You only have ${getZENI()}${user.wallet}!` (no toLocaleString) |
  | scratch (L2245/2248) | — | min/max say "scratch card price" instead of "bet" |
  Inconsistencies: mixed double-quoted vs template-literal strings; three different "insufficient funds" phrasings; scratch renames "bet"→"card price" only in error text while its result screen says "Card Cost".

```

### UI-MS-55 — Chess ultimate guide
- **Loc:** `core/games/chess.js:698-721`
- **Trigger:** `.j chess guide`
- **Type:** menu (tutorial)
- **Banner:** `♟️ *THE ULTIMATE CHESS GUIDE* ♟️` + numbered bold sections
- **Template:**
```
♟️ *THE ULTIMATE CHESS GUIDE* ♟️

*1. Making Moves* 📝
This bot uses *Standard Algebraic Notation*. You don't pick the piece first; you pick the square it moves to!

• *Pawns:* Just the square (e.g., `e4`, `d5`)
• *Knight:* `N` + square (e.g., `Nf3`)
• *Bishop:* `B` + square (e.g., `Bc4`)
• *Rook:* `R` + square (e.g., `Rd1`)
• *Queen:* `Q` + square (e.g., `Qh5`)
• *King:* `K` + square (e.g., `Ke2`)

*2. Special Moves* ✨
• *Capture:* Add `x` (e.g., `exd5` or `Nxf3`)
• *Castling:* `O-O` (Kingside) or `O-O-O` (Queenside)
• *Check:* Add `+` (e.g., `Bb5+`)
• *Promotion:* Square + `=` + Piece (e.g., `e8=Q`)

*3. How to Play* 🎮
1. Challenge someone: `${prefix} chess @user [bet]`
2. The board will be rendered. White moves first.
3. Type `${prefix} move e4` to make your opening move.
4. The bot will highlight the last move on the board.

*4. Pro Tips* ⚖️
• The goal is to put the opponent's King in *Checkmate*.
• If you're stuck, type `${prefix} chess moves` to see all your possible legal moves.
• Use `${prefix} chess undo` if you made a mistake (both players must agree in spirit!)
• If a game gets stuck, use `${prefix} chess stop` to clear it.
```
- **Example render:** (as shown; prefix `.j`)
- **Notes:** Longest text block in games/. Section 4 header emoji ⚖️ is reused from the draw/verdict symbol (semantic collision).

Handler receives no endpoint info from config — endpoint mapping is entirely in fallbacks.js (UI-MS-90). Help aliases: `.j reactions|interactions|intaractions` (typo'd alias kept, engine L7545).

### UI-MS-87 — Reaction GIF caption (targeted & self)
- **Loc:** `reactions/handler.js:175-189`
- **Trigger:** successful GIF fetch + FFmpeg MP4 conversion
- **Type:** caption (on GIF-Playback video)
- **Banner:** none
- **Template:**
```
@${cleanSender} ${type}s @${cleanTarget} ${emoji}
```
```
@${cleanSender} ${type} ${emoji}
```
- **Example render:**
```
@254712345678 kisses @254798765432 💋
```
```
@254712345678 dance 💃
```
- **Notes:** Naive grammar: appends "s" for targeted (kiss→kisses ok; yeet→yeets; animekick→animekicks). Self form uses the bare type as a verb — `@user dance 💃` works, but `@user thumbsup 👍`, `@user bored 🥱`, `@user happy 😀`, `@user tableflip ┬─┬` are ungrammatical captions. Mentions array attached ([sender, target] or [sender]); quotes the target's/replied message when present (quoteOption L124-138). Sent as `video` with `gifPlayback: true` (GIF converted via ffmpeg, L167-169). BOT_MARKER here is a literal `'🃏 '` (handler L97) — a joker card + space, DIFFERENT from engine's invisible zero-width marker.
